A lover pleads for affection and asks when the partner will commit, hoping the answer is yes.

songs.t: To Know Him Is to Love Him
songs.s: A devoted admirer adores a man who hasn't noticed her yet, dreaming he will someday see she is meant for him.
A singer advises that young love can slip away like April showers, so hold on to the one you love.
A teen boy secretly loves an older girl, hoping she'll notice him and promising to win her one day.
Dancers are invited to stroll across the floor, feeling great and heading off toward the candy store.

songs.t: Hard Headed Woman / Don't Ask Me Why
songs.s: A singer complains that stubborn women have caused trouble since the beginning of time, citing Bible stories.
A singer confesses a deep love for Peggy Sue and begs her to return the affection.
A man sits alone while his ex flirts with others, admitting he still loves her and wishes she would return.
Soldiers recall a boastful, exaggerated 1814 fight against the British at New Orleans, which they win.
A narrator tells a gruesome story about a notorious criminal named Mack who keeps his knife hidden.
A singer keeps trying to win a partner, admitting he will be a fool for their charm and heart.
A young man prays to the goddess Venus for a devoted girl who will love him forever.
A lonely young man longs for someone to love and hopes to find her.
A lonely man hopes every night that his dream lover will come and end his dreaming alone.
A village chapel rings for a man's birth, his wedding and his death, prayers offered at each moment.
A singer begs a darling to come close, hold them tight and stay all night.
A narrator announces a trip to Kansas City to find a new flame and stand on Twelfth Street.
A jilted narrator sits by the phone, hurt that a lover deceives them and never calls.

songs.t: Put Your Head on My Shoulder
songs.s: A singer asks a lover to rest their head on a shoulder and confess they love them too.
A gambling quarrel between two men ends in a barroom shooting in this murder ballad.
A narrator wanders lonely since a girl left, begging to know where she has gone.
A narrator gushes over a quirky partner's loud clothes, a stint in the army and a funeral plan.
A man mourns his lost love, whom friends had doubted, and hides his tears behind a smile.
A chorus mocks mischievous Charlie Brown, a school troublemaker who is always blamed for pranks.
A lonely narrator prays from a quiet village that a lover returns, keeping their memory alive.

songs.t: My Heart Is an Open Book
songs.s: A singer swears devotion to a partner and brushes off a jealous rival's lies that claim cheating.
A dreamy singer longs for a beloved, dreaming of holding and kissing them at any time.
A man invites his beloved to a romantic seaside escape and says how much he loves her.
A teenager insists he is ready to marry his sweetheart, even though others say he is too young.

songs.t: Sorry (I Ran All the Way Home)
songs.s: A boy runs all the way home to apologize to his girl, promising they are more than friends.
A teenager frets over quarrels and fears breakup, asking the stars why love hurts so much.
A singer celebrates a sweetheart's sixteenth birthday, calling her a teenage queen and hoping she loves them too.

songs.t: It's Just a Matter of Time
songs.s: A scorned lover predicts an ex will return, since what goes up must come down.
A jilted partner finds lipstick on their lover's collar, catching them cheating with a best friend.
A regretful narrator, left alone after breaking a lover's heart, watches her leave and begs to know why.
A playful singer asks a teasing partner for only a little affection, maybe a kiss or two.
A fatalistic song says everyone meets a defeat, from Adam to Napoleon to a killer hanged for murder.
A traditional rhyme says a singer's beloved will be queen if the singer becomes king.

songs.t: (Now and Then There's) A Fool Such as I
songs.s: A heartbroken singer admits being a sentimental fool who still loves a partner who has ended things.
A playful duet where a girl asks to borrow a comb from a hip, slangy guy who gets flirty.
A man is left in darkness after his lover leaves him, calling the loss a tragedy.
A singer says true happiness is simply loving and being loved, preferring that over wealth and thrills.
A singer brags about a lively, classy girl from Tallahassee who dances every style and out-dances everyone.
A besotted singer compares their feelings to wild animals, prowling and leaping for a sweet partner.

songs.t: Never Be Anyone Else But You
songs.s: A devoted singer swears no one else will ever match the partner, hoping to belong to them someday.
A smitten singer confesses lifelong love to someone who first caught their eye, asking whether they realize it.
A pleading singer begs a date to stay the night, wanting kisses and company in dim light.

songs.t: What a Diff'rence a Day Makes
songs.s: A singer marvels at how one day transformed sadness into joy after a partner declared commitment.
A spoken tale of a guitarist who gets famous, then gets drafted into the army and loses the guitar.
A romantic singer finds every walk with a partner feels like a holiday, even in the rain.
A heartbroken singer searches for a gloomy place where lost hopes are buried and old love dies.
A joyful call-and-response party track urging a lover to dance, shake and feel good all night.
A melody that once celebrated love now torments a singer with memories of a lost lover, who may return.
A man tells his lover she is his destiny and his one and only dream come true.
A restless wanderer, hunted by police after trouble with the law, leaves town to see a sweetheart.
A comic warning that a seductive woman brings trouble, like a plant that creeps into your life.
A young man announces he is grown up and ready to party, dance and kiss, asking to be left free.
Pleading for a lost lover to come home, with heartache and a tearful, repeated hook.
A couple vows undying love at their wedding, praising the sunny Hawaiian setting.
Advice to ask your own heart whether a faithful, caring partner truly loves you.
Advice to girls to turn down a boy's dates, kisses and ring, with playful refrains.
A jilted lover hides tears after an ex moves on, still missing and loving them.
Fed up with a flaky partner who stands them up, is never home and wants money.
Heartbroken after a breakup, begging a lost lover to come back and make a fresh start.
Being in love feels like a dream that makes the whole world glow, and dreams keep coming true.
Lists everything lost since a partner walked out, leaving only misery and an empty heart.

songs.t: The Chipmunk Song (Christmas Don't Be Late)
songs.s: Chipmunks sing about wanting toys and a date for Christmas, with a bungled Spanish compliment joke.

songs.t: I Want to Walk You Home
songs.s: A smitten suitor asks to walk someone home and hopes for a date.
Gushing that their sweetheart is so fine, loves them and gives them chills.
Advises that a girl leaving childhood for romance is old enough to give her heart away.
A WWII soldier, punished for playing cards in church, explains each card as a Bible lesson.
Anxiously wonders whether a lover truly loves them and how to know it is real.

songs.t: I Only Have Eyes for You
songs.s: Dreamy love song saying the singer sees only their beloved, ignoring everything else around.
Late getting home from a date with low gas, they dread facing their date's father.
Giddy teen calls her steady boyfriend, a high school football captain, her whole world.
Jailed in Tijuana after a gambling spot raid, the singers beg friends to send bail money.
Smitten singer says they love their partner almost too much, and is still hooked on them.
Narrator watching a TV western where a lanky hero rescues a damsel from a villain with a buzz saw.
Tribute mourning three singers called to heaven, with nods to their best-known songs.
Sweet declaration that a partner completes the singer, who would be lost without them.
Vows no one could be sweeter, and the singer will love only this partner forever.
Blames an ex for leaving and begs them to return, claiming they were the one who suffered.
Sad farewell to a lover heading off on travels, promising to wait and count the days until return.
Ballad vowing an endless, unshakable love, compared to mountains, seas and sunrises.
A jilted man counts his heartaches one by one as his lover returns and leaves him again.
Upbeat invitation to dance and go on a sea cruise, joining in the rocking rhythm.
Lists the caring ways a lover makes the singer feel, saying that's why they love them.
Smitten singer calls a partner so fine, says their heart skips a beat and talks about them constantly.
Across America, the singer says summer is the season for kisses and asks his girl to kiss him.
Giddy singer finds true love after a long search, warns the partner not to play with feelings.
Tomorrow luck will return, the singer hopes, though today feels poor, sunless and lonely.
A five-year-old boasts in nonsense syllables that a three-year-old sweetheart loves them.
A jailed frontier outlaw sends word to his left-behind love, hiding what he did and where he is.

songs.t: The Battle Hymn of the Republic
songs.s: Hymn picturing God's righteous judgment and triumph amid war camps, as a glorious march forward.
A woman flirts with a handsome man at a dance, and he says he is ready to dance and kiss.

songs.t: Seven Little Girls Sitting in the Back Seat
songs.s: A joking driver describes seven girls smooching Fred in the back seat while he drives them.
Ode to a love that makes any place a summer haven, storms and worries aside.
Caller asks a partner, with another man present, to say whether they really love the caller.
Spurned singer scorns Cathy's deceitful clown and says they want no more of her love.
Two lovers from warring tribes swim across a river to meet, and drown together in the current.
A grieving teen speaks to a lost love who died on railroad tracks, asking if they still hear.
A young woman apologizes to her lover for being foolish and hopes he will accept her apology.
Urgent plea to seize the moment, hold a beloved tonight and not wait for tomorrow.
A smooth-talking suitor advertises fixing broken hearts, promising sweet words and round-the-clock availability.
Playful declaration that the singer is glued to a partner, who can never escape them.
Party rap remix urging everyone to do the twist, shouting out fellow performers and dance moves.
A heartbroken woman admits she keeps returning to a man who treats her carelessly, accepting being used.
A swaggering suitor vows to tame a flirtatious girl who juggles many boys and wants her devoted to him alone.
Singer mourns vanished green fields and rivers, and waits for a lover who ran away to come home.

songs.t: What in the World's Come Over You
songs.s: A man asks his lover what changed, says he misses her every night, and promises to wait for her return.
A man kills a rival for a cantina dancer, flees on horseback, and dies in her arms on a hill above town.
A cartoon caveman brags about being the toughest man alive, riding a dinosaur through the jungle while the beasts keep away.

songs.t: My Heart Has a Mind of Its Own
songs.s: A woman admits she still loves a man who left, unable to stop thinking of him even when she tries to move on.
A teenage girl delights in the whispered sweet nothings her boyfriend says to her at school, on walks, and at her porch.

songs.t: Itsy Bitsy Teenie Weenie Yellow Polkadot Bikini
songs.s: A shy girl hides in a locker and then under a blanket, too nervous to show off her new bikini at the beach.
A lonely singer says only lonely people understand his heartache over a lost love and hopes a new romance will come.
Two lovers feel they have met and loved before, puzzled that they cannot recall when or where it happened.
A girl lists sixteen reasons she loves her boyfriend, from how he holds her hand to the whispers they share on the phone.
A teenager insists his love is real, not a silly crush, and begs his ex to come back.
Two lovers repeatedly declare their perfect love and faithfulness, promising to love each other forever.

songs.t: Save the Last Dance for Me
songs.s: A singer tells his partner to dance with anyone at the party, but to save the last dance for him.
A singer tells his lover she has everything it takes to win his heart and make him commit forever.
A crew hunts and sinks the German battleship Bismarck in 1941 after it destroys the British ship Hood.
Men working a road gang sing all day, longing to return home to their women.
A man asks his lover to be his only love and to never leave him lonely.
A singer credits good timing for meeting his love, citing David, Columbus, and other historic moments that turned on luck.
A sailor imagines his lover waiting for him beyond the sea, and promises to sail home to her.
A confident young man boasts about his talking, dancing, and kissing skills while his date keeps telling him to go.
Each night a singer dreams of his absent lover, who returns to his arms only in his dreams.
A man burns his ex's letters, sells the house they shared, and moves away to forget her.
A woman waits by the clock for a lover who keeps leaving, dreading the pain each time he goes.
A narrator watches young couples in love and recalls their own romance, envying the bright hopeful feeling they share.
A lonely man describes a life of trouble and heartache, writing a letter to a stranger who might be lonely too.
A young man falls for the girl next door with pretty blue eyes and plans to wait on her steps to tell her he loves her.

songs.t: Way Down Yonder in New Orleans
songs.s: A singer praises New Orleans as a dreamy paradise of beautiful women and tender flirting, urging listeners to linger.
A woman realizes her lover's sweet words were fake, like paper roses, and sends back the flowers he gave her.
A frightened soldier begs Custer to let him leave the 7th Cavalry, dreading the coming battle and the hidden Indians.
A lonely young woman longs to be wanted right now and to share her laughter and tears with someone special.
A mule skinner offers his services to a captain, boasting he can make any mule listen, with silly laughing and calls.
A singer turns nursery rhymes like Jack Be Nimble into a playful love song about rocking in the cradle of love.
A singer says his partner lacks money, looks, and fancy things but has what it takes to set his soul on fire.
A married narrator begs someone to close the door on temptation, admitting they are falling for a person they cannot have.
A devoted lover says they pray each night their partner will still be there, promising a love that lasts for eternity.
Everyone is invited to finger-pop as friends arrive to join the dance, feeling good as the sax takes over.
A narrator watches harbor lights as a lover sails away, fearing another harbor will steal their love.
A shy wallflower finally gathers the nerve to dance, and the singer asks a partner to let her through.
A woman tells an ex who broke too many dates that she has found someone new, and he will have to stay.
A couple flies up to a dreamy place away from crowds, singing in the glow of a star.
Young lovers say their parents bet their love will fail, but they forgive them and insist their love is one in a million.
A traveler recounts the wonder of visiting Lourdes and kneeling in prayer at the grotto of St. Bernadette.
A singer remembers an old lamplighter who once brightened the streets, recalling his kindness and wishing those days back.
A smitten singer cannot tell whether a sweetheart is a devil or an angel, but wants her to be theirs.
A flirty young man juggles several girlfriends around town until one of them turns him down for being untrue.
A lover asks to be held and kissed, and to hear that love will last forever.
A sleepless narrator dreams about the ideal girl he hopes to find and love.
A suitor pleads with a teasing girlfriend to say yes and stop playing hard to get.
A smitten singer praises a love that outdoes everything and begs to hear it returned.

songs.t: I Love the Way You Love
songs.s: A happy lover celebrates a partner's devotion and vows to stay loyal despite what others say.
A girl gleefully warns a rival that her returning boyfriend will punish her for spreading lies.
A racer dies in a crash, and his final words send love and a message to his sweetheart.
A singer remembers her mother and the years they spent together, and promises to keep her close in memory.
A man hears his ex's footsteps walking away and keeps praying she will come back to him.
A singer mourns a relationship that has gone bad, remembering the good times before love died.
A singer promises to come running whenever a lonely lover calls and wants to start a romance.
A broke narrator leaves a faithless lover and walks home to New Orleans for good.
A woman sifts through keepsakes of an old romance, finding only memories and a broken heart.
A teen singer hypes a swinging school where the dancing is hot and the crush is cool.

songs.t: A Rockin' Good Way (to Mess Around and Fall in Love)
songs.s: A flirtatious duet praises playful affection as an easy way to drift into falling for someone.
A singer vows to climb to the highest star and build a stairway to heaven to reach his angelic girl.
A singer returns to his hometown, falls in love, and feels the whole town fill with music.
A singer aches for Georgia and a beloved who waits there, with no peace until he returns.
A singer chants nonsense about sweet cherry pie and sugar plums, teasing for a sweet treat from his girl.
A man admits he's no scholar but loves a girl, and dreams of a wonderful world together.
A heartbroken singer says luck has deserted him and he cannot stop thinking about a lost love.
A singer recounts how a romance grew step by step, from a first hello to a promise of lasting love.
A carefree singer laughs and smiles through hard times, happy with the moon, the sun and his sweetheart.
A teen singer describes young love as a whole world and promises forever with one special girl.
A lonely singer keeps dreaming and searching for someone to love him until his dream comes true.
A singer invites a lover to escape the crowds and float off together, with a heart full of song.
A girl prays to God that a boy will notice her and that she can be his love.
A fed-up partner complains that a gossipy lover talks too much about other people, worrying everyone.
A lonely narrator keeps getting cheated and mistreated by lovers and asks when someone will truly love him.
A singer begs listeners to focus on living and loving instead of songs about death and violence.

songs.t: My Little Corner of the World
songs.s: A singer invites a sweetheart to a private little corner of the world to dream and stay close.
A jealous lover tells a cheating partner to stop running around or be dropped, though he still loves her.
A young man searches the big world for the little girl he is sure is out there to love.
A man demands money, insisting that romance cannot pay the bills and cash is all he wants.
A young man begs his girl to stay a little longer for one more dance and a kiss.
A jilted narrator copes through the workweek, but weekends alone since the breakup hurt the most.
A man is hopelessly smitten with a girl named Sandy, and he sees her everywhere he goes.
A restless narrator lies awake all night, unable to stop thinking about a girl who has him spellbound.
A woman breaks down each time she sees her former lover and cannot be merely friends with him.
A spiritual calls on Michael and a sister to row across a deep river to a promised land beyond.
A man hides that he is still crying over a lover who left him and no longer loves him.
A man walks in the rain, wondering why his lover ran away and where she will go.
A narrator tells the sad story of two lovers who part, with names changed to protect the people involved.
A dance call tells the crowd to do the pony, turning left and right, and get up on the floor.
A singer invites friends to a rowdy down-the-road joint with a piano, a bass and some boogie.
A man whose love has left him says his tears are only raindrops, since men are not supposed to cry.
A lover begs his partner not to break his heart, because he is not made of wood and will cry.

songs.t: Take Good Care of My Baby
songs.s: A jilted ex asks the man now with his girl to treat her kindly, or else send her back home.
A narrator fears losing his love to a returning rival, but she chooses to walk away with him.

songs.t: Dedicated to the One I Love
songs.s: A singer far from her lover dedicates a song to him and asks him to pray for her nightly.
A girl asks whether her lover's affection will last beyond tonight, wanting reassurance before she gives in.
A young woman waits for her true love to turn up somewhere in the crowd, sure he is looking for her too.
A man tells a mistreating woman to leave for good, though he says he will bounce back anyway.
A woman sees her boyfriend kiss her best friend at the movies, then goes home hiding her tears from her mother.
A man complains that his meddling mother-in-law undermines his home and wishes she would leave them alone.
Kids in Bristol show off a dance called the Bristol Stomp, and the singer invites a partner to join in.
A globe-trotting man boasts of a sweetheart in every port, from Mexico and Berlin to Hong Kong and Alaska.
A mother advises her son to date many women before picking one who truly loves him back.
A boll weevil pest tells a farmer it is moving in to stay, ruining his cotton crop as a comic tale.
God builds the world and a woman from a hundred pounds of clay, and the singer thanks Him for love.
A lover separated by distance vows to keep faith and hopes to be reunited someday.
Heartbroken singer tells an ex not to worry about him, saying he will manage and wishing her well.
No painter could capture the singer's love, a dream too miraculous to be seen, even by Michelangelo.
A woman recounts dancing until a quarter to three at a swinging night out with Daddy G and his band.

songs.t: Who Put the Bomp (in the Bomp, Bomp, Bomp)
songs.s: A man thanks the songwriter whose catchy nonsense syllables made his sweetheart fall in love with him.
A man adores his sweetheart and imagines a romantic moment for every month of the year, from prom to Christmas.
The singer invites listeners to a neighborhood hangout where dancing and rocking away the blues is the whole point.
A woman warns her lover not to bet on their love, since he has lied before and she expects him to lie again.
Singer says life is empty since a lover left, and he cannot imagine living without her.
God sends a dove as a sign of love, as in the story of Noah, to comfort believers in hard times.
A man warns a younger sister not to follow her older sister's ways, then flirts with her instead.
A lonely singer finds love under the blue moon, and the moon turns to gold as a sudden new romance begins.
A man returns home for good to his waiting lover, promising he is no longer away and will stay with her.
A couple breaks up for good, and the singer is heartbroken, losing someone and living from day to day.

songs.t: (I Don't Know Why) But I Do
songs.s: A lovesick singer cannot explain why he still loves someone who left, and sleepless nights prove it.
A self-proclaimed troublemaker relishes her bad reputation, shrugs off accusations and dares critics to see her wicked side.
A heartbroken singer talks to the walls, window and ceiling of his room since his lover walked out on him.
A singer warns listeners about Sue, who takes a man's love and then runs around with every other guy in town.
Singer envies a free yellow bird while his own girl has flown off again, wishing he could fly away too.
Singer feels deeply wounded that a lover lied and moved on, yet still loves them and would never hurt them.
A young man falls instantly for Mary Lou after she passes him by, and promises he will never part from her.
A young man invites his sweetheart for a moonlit stroll and feels a glow he has never felt before.
Singer asks his lover to surrender to him under the moonlight, promising a night of love and devotion.

songs.t: I Love How You Love Me
songs.s: A woman lists the tender ways her lover kisses, holds and misses her, cherishing how he loves her.
A man waits impatiently for his girl to arrive, fearing she is not coming, and tells her he loves her.
Students celebrate the end of school with fun, dancing and dates, and a night of partying with Daddy G.

songs.t: You Don't Know What You've Got (Until You Lose It)
songs.s: A man realizes too late how much he has lost after mistreating his lover, and begs her to come back to him.
A lonely man begs his lover to walk right back to him, since nothing feels the same since she left.
A man adores his lover's smile, warm cheeks and laugh, and asks that she never change, loving her just as she is.
A man finds his lover drowned in a muddy river, and her note confessing wrongs leaves him staring at his own loss.
A heartbroken man wishes his former love well with the man she is marrying and asks him to treat her kindly.
A girl is smitten by a nice guy with hypnotic eyes, hopes their love grows, and can only exclaim gee whiz.
Singer promises to stay steady for his love through any darkness or upheaval, asking her to stand by him.
A man is captivated by a girl he compares to a red rose growing through the concrete of Spanish Harlem.
A woman is thrilled her man is finally hers and believes their love will work out, despite his playboy past.
A singer begs a hesitant lover to stop resisting, insisting they both want each other and should let go.
A couple dance while babysitting, and the baby loves the boogie beat, rocking along until bedtime.
A jilted man tells his ex, who dumped him for Larry, that she now gets the heartbreak she gave him.
A lover says oldies on the radio bring back memories of a partner now far away.
A dance caller urges everyone to join the fly, flapping their arms and buzzing around the floor.
Heartbroken narrator hears from an old friend that his ex has a new love and hides his pain.
A lover blesses a departing partner and insists their love will endure despite the separation.
A smitten narrator tells the stars and brooks about their love and hopes it is returned.
A man admits he can think only of his girl and would rather hold her than join his friends' plans.
Singer adores a girl who feels like heaven, promising to love her and begging her never to leave.
A singer adores a lover's angel eyes and promises an eternal love in repeated devotion.
A jilted narrator still loves a partner who broke their vows and says it is too late to turn back.

songs.t: Does Your Chewing Gum Lose Its Flavour (On the Bedpost Overnight?)
songs.s: A playful novelty song asks silly questions about chewing gum, a wedding and the White House.

songs.t: Breakin' in a Brand New Broken Heart
songs.s: A heartbroken narrator shuts out friends, cries alone and asks to be left alone until the pain passes.
A young woman recalls her mother's warning that hard days come, and tries to stay hopeful through them.
A smitten singer praises a girl he likes, asks her to trust him and declares love from every direction.
A man sees signs his lover's heart has turned cold and accepts that the relationship is over.
A man gushes about a woman who looks, talks and cooks like an angel and who loves him back.
A lover begs to be held and kissed tonight, promising forever love while mandolins play.
A giant miner sacrifices himself to save trapped men after a mine collapse and is remembered on a marker.
A singer hails his girl as dynamite and invites a wild night of twisting and loving her.
A man likens himself to a rubber ball that keeps bouncing back to a lover who stretches him thin.
Singer longs for his absent lover, wishing she were home with him and waiting for her letters of love.
A teen flirts on a low-lit night, with the radio playing softly, and begs to hear she loves him.

songs.t: I'm Gonna Knock on Your Door
songs.s: A boy vows to knock, ring and howl outside until his girl comes out under the bright moon.
A jilted singer promises an ex who has moved on loyal friendship and a place to lean whenever needed.
A dance anthem urges everyone to twist again like last summer, with the good times back in full swing.
A man asks an ex whether she is lonely tonight and recalls a love that ended like a play he never wanted to finish.
A man adrift in heartbreak begs a lost love to rescue him from a sea of tears.

songs.t: More Money for You and Me
songs.s: A comic medley mocks rival groups and jokes about sending them away so the singers can earn more.

songs.t: You Must Have Been a Beautiful Baby
songs.s: A singer teasingly imagines his lover as a dazzling baby who wowed the kindergarten and won every prize.
Singer begs his lover not to leave, asking whether she will walk out again as she did before.
A heartbroken man says he will live in memories of lonesome times because he cannot stop loving someone gone.
Upbeat call to learn the mashed potato dance, which spreads through every crowd and every kind of song.
A narrator recalls a high school sweetheart who moved on, then wishes her daughter luck with her own yearbook love.
A teen girl dreams of a boy she adores, waiting by the phone and hoping he someday loves her back.
Singer invites everyone to learn the easy new Loco-motion dance, swinging hips and jumping up and back.
Someone outside a dance party begs to be let in, hearing the music and seeing the silhouettes of dancers.
A girl promises her soldier boyfriend she will stay true to him, wherever he goes across any shore.
Singer thanks his sweetheart for entering his life, saying her love matters more than his poverty and vowing devotion.
A brash guy boasts he never settles down, roaming from town to town and dating girls everywhere he goes.
A confident suitor boasts he is unstoppable and promises his girl a royal future, chanting the title.
A boy recalls a night at an amusement park with rides, hot dogs and a dance, and falling in love there.

songs.t: Breaking Up Is Hard to Do
songs.s: A man begs his girl not to end things, pleading to make up again instead of breaking up.
A suitor climbs a mountain to court a farmer's daughter despite her father's warning, daring him to take his life.
A couple slows the twist down, taking their time to tease and please each other on the dance floor.
A man cries himself to sleep, lonely since his lover left, and the hurt keeps going.

songs.t: The One Who Really Loves You
songs.s: A girl warns her wavering boyfriend that rival girls only want him and begs him to choose her.
A singer says his lover is worth more than any lucky charm and asks her to be his good luck charm tonight.
A boy gushes about his sweet girl Sheila, who has blue eyes and says she loves him and will never leave.
A party invitation to a New York place where everyone dances the twist all night, with a handkerchief game.
Hype for a dance craze, urging listeners to try the Watusi and the Fly for romance.
Invitation to learn the new Peppermint Twist dance at a club on 45th Street, repeating its steps.
Pleading with a departing lover to end things gently, vowing never to love again.
A woman warns a womanizing playboy to stay away, refusing to be hurt like his other lovers.
A singer loves a free-roaming lover and asks who could ever hold on to her.
A lover promises to write every day over a lonely summer apart, sealing each letter with a kiss.
A man breaks up with a girl who cries, insisting his affection has faded and he has found someone new.

songs.t: Don't Break the Heart That Loves You
songs.s: A jealous lover begs her partner not to break her heart, pleading for fairness and kindness.
A man invites an older woman to do the twist, claiming the dance keeps you from growing old.
A girl declares her devotion to Norman, turning down other dates because she only wants him.
Singer finds comfort in her lover's letters, memorizing every line and reading them again while they are apart.
A teen watches a party across the street from her room, begging her mother to let her go.
Recalls childhood in the cotton fields back home, where hard work earned little money.
Urges a girl to twist and shout and show she is his, with the chant repeated throughout.

songs.t: Theme from Dr. Kildare (Three Stars Will Shine Tonight)
songs.s: Three stars shine over the lonely, young lovers, and a wish on the third star brings hope for love.
Singer begs his departing lover to come back, pleading not to be left in misery after a love story went wrong.

songs.t: I Know (You Don't Love Me No More)
songs.s: Singer accepts that her lover no longer wants her, refusing to keep crying over him or hang around any longer.
Singer tells his sweetheart that love makes the whole world a treasure, asking her to promise forever.
A woman insists she loves her man despite what others say, because he is the only one for her.
A wife scolds her wandering husband Speedy for drinking, flirting and neglecting home, and begs him to return.
A man planned to smile as his lover left, but one tear ruins his act.
A jilted lover hides heartbreak, crying only in the rain so the ex never sees the tears.
A singer declares that a beloved is everything beyond the sea, the limits of the world and even death.
A party anthem urging everyone to shout, dance and feed the jukebox a coin while the night gets going.
Singer stops a girl on the corner, asking her name and whether he can walk her home and be her one.
Secret lovers meet in smoky clubs, hoping the woman's husband will soon free her.
Sam Cooke invites listeners to keep the party going at home, dancing to the radio and calling in requests.
Singer loves a friend who never knows his feelings, and watches her leave with another man, too shy to speak.
A singer begs Sherry to sneak out to his twist party, promising to make her his.
A girl wants her boyfriend Johnny to get angry and stand up for himself, showing he really cares.
Singer admits he cannot help falling in love, believing some things are simply meant to be.
Shout-along party number where a singer tells his leaving girl she was good to him.
Two dreamy drifters set off to see the world, chasing a rainbow with a river as their companion.
A comic spoken tale of a sheik who sneaks off to meet a harem dancer, ending in a playful twist.
A lonely man sits at his window remembering the walks, kisses and sailboat rides he shared with his lost love.
A feared gunman terrorizes a frontier town until a stranger with a law book shoots him in a showdown.
A singer asks his traveling lover to remember that she belongs to him while she sees the world.

songs.t: Dream Baby (How Long Must I Dream)
songs.s: Singer longs for a lover who fills his dreams, asking how long he must wait for them to come true.
A man who lost his love begs her to call him back, promising to do anything to win her back.
A jilted man claims he is happy and fine after a lover left him, though he admits he still pines.
Singer invites a girl to dance the twist, stomp and mashed potato, asking her to let him walk her home.
A teen skips school, TV and radio to write a song and poem for Cindy's birthday.

songs.t: You Beat Me to the Punch
songs.s: A woman fears a man will leave her, so she resolves to walk away first if he does.
A woman warns her partner to treat her right or lose a good thing, threatening to walk out the door.
A worker is belittled downtown but stands tall uptown with his partner, where he feels like a king.
A jilted singer says friends keep showing sympathy, but none of it brings back the lover who left.
A young man, forbidden to love a poor town girl, learns she drowned and resolves to follow.
A singer adores a girl in blue jeans, calling her his Cinderella and the eighth wonder of the world.
Singer begs his beloved for tender, warm love, promising to be hers forever and fly away together.
A teen idol admits that fame doesn't cure his loneliness and longs for someone to share his troubles.
A heartbroken singer keeps mementos of a lost love, now that the one he loved belongs to someone else.
A jilted lover learns by letter that his girl has fallen for a tall dark stranger and is ending things.
A man describes the lover who treated him like royalty, then left him heartbroken and taken for a fool.
A narrator recalls a hardworking farmhand who dreamed of climbing a mountain before dying, and a dry sunny field.
A jilted lover insists his cheerful laughing hides no heartbreak, even when tears fall at parties.
Singer begs an ex to explain what went wrong, asking whether he is just a memory and saying it matters.
Kennedy's PT boat is sunk in the Pacific war, and he tows a burned crewman through the sea to save him.
A heartbroken singer begs a cruel girlfriend to stop tearing his heart apart, knowing he can't live without her.
A singer urges a girl to join the twist dance craze, shaking, jumping and bringing a partner along.
A man laments a woman who keeps taking all his money, so he runs off to Las Vegas to escape her.
A singer tells his dance partner he wants more than dancing, asking for romance and affection with cheeky innuendo.
Heartbroken singer swears he will never dance again, watching his former partner in another man's arms.
A blue singer begs a lover to come home, hoping a fortune teller's doom prediction about their love was wrong.

songs.t: Where Have All the Flowers Gone?
songs.s: Repeating question traces flowers, girls, young men and soldiers to graveyards, asking when people will ever learn.
A father tells his teenage son that girls were made to love, guiding him through dating and the first kiss.
Young lovers say a judgmental town's pity and gossip threatens to tear their love apart.
Singer pictures spreading justice, freedom and love across the whole land with a hammer, a bell and a song.

songs.t: I Wish That We Were Married
songs.s: Steady teen couple wishes they were married so they'd never have to say goodbye or feel lonely apart.
An invitation to go surfing with a woody full of boards, heading out on a surf safari to beaches and islands.
A rousing surf anthem imagining everyone surfing across the nation, naming beaches all over the coast.
Singer wonders why the world carries on normally after a lover's goodbye, since for her it has ended.
A heartbroken singer listens to falling rain, grieving the girl who left with his heart and asking the rain to send love back.
A smitten narrator crushes on a handsome boy with wavy hair and vows to make him hers, whatever it takes.
A narrator remembers a lover who wore blue velvet, warm memories now bittersweet since she left.
Teen sweethearts promise to marry and build a life together once school is over, waiting and hoping their wishes come true.
A live crowd call-and-response with shouted cheers, clapping along and a cheerful goodbye, mostly ad-libbed.

songs.t: Can't Get Used to Losing You
songs.s: Singer can't get used to a lost love, going out to crowds but feeling empty and missing her for life.
A girl warns a gossiping rival that her boyfriend is back and will teach her a lesson for spreading lies.
A lonely narrator walks with eyes lifted so tears won't fall, remembering spring, summer and autumn days spent together.
A couple strolling by the sea is so in love they plan to walk down the aisle and vow forever.
A boy grows up and leaves his magic dragon friend, who sadly retreats into his cave and stops roaring.
Protest song posing rhetorical questions about war, freedom and suffering, answered only by the wind.
A band recounts a wild tour and a California beach party that ends in a chaotic wipeout.
A man loves his partner for understanding him and always being there, cherishing her for simply being herself.
A singer says his loved one is the reason he lives, the one who carries him through life's burdens and makes him whole.
A jilted young man, urged on by his father, vows to walk away strong from a cruel girl who spread lies about him.
A singer lists the gifts a suitor promised, a mockingbird, a ring and peace of mind, and decides to go with the flow.
Girl vows to follow her beloved anywhere, through any ocean or mountain, since he is her destiny.
A surf-trip anthem: a driver hauls his woody to Surf City, where two girls for every boy means endless fun.
A heartbroken girl throws a party but cries when her boyfriend shows up with another girl, wearing his ring.

songs.t: Blame It on the Bossa Nova
songs.s: A bride-to-be credits a bossa nova dance at a party for sparking her romance, planning a family to tell the story to.
A dance-floor command: keep moving, shaking and flying around the floor because nobody is allowed to sit down.
A singer feels a burning desire for her lover, tears streaming as the feeling tears her apart like a heat wave.
A smitten singer serenades Denise with doo-wop refrains, declaring love and asking her to hold him tight and kiss goodnight.
An offbeat invitation to walk right in, sit down and let your mind roll on, a new way of walking that might blow your mind.
A playful advice song claiming a plainer wife makes for a happier marriage than a pretty one.
A call for justice and unity, picturing a hammer, a bell and a song spreading warnings and love.
A shy singer loves someone deeply but cannot bring herself to show it while friends urge her on.
A singer pursues a girl named Ruby, vowing to win her heart away from the other guys around her.
Young lovers promise that their romance will eventually be fulfilled if they wait patiently and stay devoted.
A woman is thrilled to see an ex return and begs him not to tease her if he leaves.
A smitten narrator begs a new love to commit and promises devotion and adoration forever.
An invitation to meet friends on a popular street for dancing and a good time.
A wistful look back at a golden romance that faded away, leaving only memories and regret.
An invitation to a dance craze, urging everyone to find the groove and let loose.
Singer celebrates finding his perfect candy girl, sweet and thrilling, who vows to love him forever.
A man keeps returning to a coffee house, then marries the girl who works there and reminisces fondly.
Singer still loves a lost lover, keeping hope alive that she might one day come home.
Heartbroken since a breakup, the narrator walks the old streets and dreams of a lost lover.
Singer welcomes back a crying lover left by another, promising to always be there for her.
A heartbroken singer pretends to be happy after a breakup, hiding sorrow behind a cheerful front.
A broke man lists his troubles, from unpaid bills to lost crops, and asks his brother for a loan.
A smitten narrator recalls meeting a boy early in the week and hopes to make him theirs.
A girl tells a rival it's too late to win back an ex who has already moved on.
Dreaming of a lost lover, the narrator finds them only at night and wakes up alone at dawn.
Singer pleads with a hurt lover to trust him, promising constant devotion and endless ways to prove his love.

songs.t: I Can't Stay Mad at You
songs.s: A woman who has been cheated on admits she always forgives her partner and takes them back.
A woman accepts that her partner has moved on, saying goodbye and telling him not to mourn her.
A man jokes his girlfriend is nearly as mean as he is and she makes him swoon.
A jilted ex says they'll enjoy watching the one who wronged them get their heart broken in turn.

songs.t: You've Really Got a Hold on Me
songs.s: Torn between love and resentment, the narrator wants to leave a mistreating partner but stays.
A narrator warns a heartbroken girl to hide her grief and avoid town, where her boyfriend is cheating.
Singer realizes his angelic-looking lover is a devil who fooled and lied to him, and now sees through her.
An upbeat call to enjoy a summer of beaches, drive-ins, snacks and sunshine.
An energetic call to the dance floor, urging a partner to shake loose and dance all night.
A smitten man calls his sweetheart his greatest treasure, saying he works hard to give her everything.
Dreaming at night of a lost lover, the narrator imagines meeting them again in a dreamlike place.

songs.t: From a Jack to a King
songs.s: The narrator escapes loneliness and wins a beloved's heart, likening romance to a winning card game.
The narrator escapes daily stress and crowds by climbing to a rooftop, inviting a lover to join them.
Tempted by someone else, the narrator knows they should leave before giving in, fearing their partner's reaction.
A young woman warns that she won't fall for boys' flirting tricks, having heeded her mother's advice.

songs.t: The Night Has a Thousand Eyes
songs.s: The narrator warns a cheating partner that others will always see through their lies and that they'll be caught.

songs.t: Don't Say Nothin' Bad (About My Baby)
songs.s: A singer defends a boyfriend against gossip, insisting he's loyal and that critics should keep quiet.
The narrator describes falling hard into a fiery, overwhelming passion that keeps burning.
A singer instantly falls for someone after one look, hoping to win them over and keep them.

songs.t: Hello Muddah, Hello Fadduh (A Letter from Camp)
songs.s: A kid writes home from summer camp with comic complaints about illness, wildlife and boredom, begging to come home.
A girl whose boyfriend left her for a rival gets him back, and the rival now has to cry.
A dying stockman jokes with his mates about his animals and asks them to look after them.
A nervous lover admits the risk but still asks to be welcomed into their partner's life.
A man complains his fickle girlfriend, craving glamour, dumped him because he had no money.
The narrator fondly recalls the summer Sunday they met, when nature seemed to urge their first kiss.
A lonely newcomer with money to spend complains he has no one to date on a Saturday night.
A man asks a tempting young woman to leave, admitting he's committed elsewhere but struggling to resist.

songs.t: Take These Chains from My Heart
songs.s: A jilted narrator begs an ex to free them from pain so they can find someone new.
Singer begs his sweetheart to keep talking, adoring the sweet words of love she speaks to him.
A jilted woman tells her ex to collect the keepsakes he left, since she has moved on.
A dance-craze song urging a partner to do the bird and fly high together.
A reassuring soul song telling listeners that everything will be fine and to enjoy life.
Car racer challenges a rival at the drag strip, revving his fuel-injected Stingray to beat him and shut him down.
A woman predicts her wandering ex will someday return and want her as his girl.
A singer warns a friend that a flirtatious girl will break his heart.
A narrator recalls a hard-hitting preacher who taught him to face life's trials alone.
Upbeat dance chant asking a baby to shake it, with repeated food and dance refrains.
A visitor from Earth finds Martians dancing a hop and joins in before returning home.
A devoted lover celebrates the wonders of a love shared by the sea, hills and quiet evenings.
A lonely man longs to return to Abilene, the prettiest town he has ever seen.
Singer keeps losing his woman, who walks out again and again, so he says he needs a part-time love.
A man who moved to Detroit for work longs to go home to his family in the country.
A young man walks twenty miles to see his girl every day, singing along the way.
A restless wanderer leaves home for greener pastures and says he will roam where he pleases.
Singer begs his girl not to leave, saying he would be devastated and cannot imagine life without her.

songs.t: I Want to Hold Your Hand
songs.s: A smitten narrator confesses his feelings and asks his love to let him hold her hand.
A narrator relays that a girl still loves a boy who hurt her, urging him to apologize.
A returning woman is greeted warmly by old friends who welcome her back to the city.
A man is charmed by a passing woman and begs her to stay and be his.
Boasts about cruising from town to town with friends, cool cars and never missing the girls.
A man sings that his sometime has arrived in a beloved's kiss, finding love right here.
A woman declares her loyalty to her boyfriend and refuses to let anyone else take him away.
A singer promises a lover a year of sunshine and laughter before she moves on, keeping her heart guarded.

songs.a: J. Frank Wilson and the Cavaliers
songs.s: Singer grieves his girlfriend, killed in a car crash, believing she is in heaven and remembering their last kiss.
A pleading lover asks why his partner is leaving him after promising a love forever.
A spoken intro and song say that needing other people is life's greatest fortune.
A hard-working man is exhausted by his day, but coming home to his partner makes everything right.
Simple plea to a lover, promising to always be true and asking to be loved back.
A man falls for a girl who walks him home, and they plan a wedding soon.
A singer complains his girl never tries, pleads for reciprocity and admits to feeling blue.
An invitation for everyone to dance in the street, with music playing in cities across the country.
A grown-up flirts with a sister while warning kids to keep quiet, offering candy for silence.

songs.t: Love Me with All Your Heart (Cuando Calienta El Sol)
songs.s: A lover asks for total devotion, steady kisses and unwavering love whether near or far.
A couple plans to spend a sunny day lounging and making love on a blanket under the boardwalk.
A couple heads to the chapel to marry, promising never to feel lonely again.
Singer doubts his lover's love, suspecting she sees someone else and asking her to wait so his fears fade.
A giddy lover promises loyalty and devotion, saying he is thrilled that his sweetheart is his.
Singer loves a poor girl mocked for hand-me-down clothes, wishing he could give her finer things.
Singer urges Dawn to leave him for a richer man, since he can't give her a better future.
A man discovers his girl with another man and swears off her cooking and affection.

songs.t: It Hurts to Be in Love
songs.s: A man is sad that his love for a girl goes unreturned, forced to hide his feelings and stay friends.
A drag race between two cars ends in a crash at a deadly curve that no one returns from.
A man flirts with a woman at a cafe, then flees a jealous boyfriend who catches them dancing.
A lonely narrator hides away, waiting for a true love while refusing a world without love.
A smitten narrator asks permission to hold and kiss a girl and begs her to come back right away.

songs.t: Don't Let the Rain Come Down (Crooked Little Man)
songs.s: A crooked man with a leaky roof fears flooding and tries to fix it with crooked tools.
Singer begs her lover not to throw their love away, feeling lonely and asking why he treats her badly.
Singer asks his beloved to choose him alone and never leave him lonely, since love with her feels complete.
Advice to a girl that wishing and dreaming won't win love; she must show a man she cares.
Singer insists on her independence, refusing to be controlled or put on display and asking to be herself.
Singer asks an ex to walk on by without stopping, hiding tears because seeing him breaks her down completely.

songs.t: The House of the Rising Sun
songs.s: A poor drifter in New Orleans warns young people away from the gambling and drinking that ruined him.
A young driver saves up to buy a hot Pontiac and show off on the drag strip.
A joyful, shouted party anthem celebrating a new love and an invitation to dance.
A man begs a telephone operator to reach his young love in Memphis, kept apart by her mother.
A narrator watches his childhood sweetheart marry someone else, hiding his heartbreak.
A driver races his Cobra against Corvettes and Jaguars at the drag strip, winning easily.

songs.t: The Shoop Shoop Song (It's in His Kiss)
songs.s: A girl asks how to tell if a boy truly loves her, and says his kiss reveals it.
A jilted lover says she is falling apart after being left and told it was only a game.
A lover praises a sweet boyfriend who makes her heart race and says he must never leave.

songs.t: Um, Um, Um, Um, Um, Um
songs.s: A man hears a stranger moaning on a bench, then understands his grief after losing a love.
A grandmother drives a red Dodge like a racer, terrorizing Colorado Boulevard.

songs.t: Don't Let the Sun Catch You Crying
songs.s: A comforting song telling a heartbroken person not to cry until the morning light.
A summer romance fades as autumn and goodbye arrive, leaving memories and dreams of the lost lover.
A man watches a graceful young woman walk to the sea and sighs over love he cannot speak.
A singer insists love cannot be bought and that he cares little for money or diamond rings.
A woman remembers sweet walks with the boyfriend who left across the sea and now loves someone new.
A singer teaches listeners a swimming-style dance craze and invites them to join in.

songs.t: Do You Want to Know a Secret
songs.s: A singer whispers a secret confessing love and asks the listener to keep it quiet.
A singer vows to keep pushing through every obstacle, with pride and soul.
A man pleads that he needs his lover's love, lonely and unable to live without her.
A girl is blue because her boyfriend joined the Navy and sends letters and souvenirs from far away.
A man asks his beloved Diane to smile for him so he can find his way home in the dark.
A rider takes his date out on a Honda motorbike and promises a thrilling ride through the hills.
A teenager gulps homemade wine and moonshine with friends and laughs off the burn.
A clown hides his heartbreak behind a smile after his girl walked away and never came back.
A man says he cares about his girl and asks only for one kiss to make him happy.
A young man dreams of finding work and a car so his love can be remembered like Romeo and Juliet.
A man promises to gather stars and lay clover at his beloved's feet, doing anything for her.
A singer savors life today, enjoying its sweetness before tomorrow arrives.

songs.t: Can't You See That She's Mine
songs.s: A man insists he and his girl will stay together despite others trying to pull them apart.
A girl mourns her biker boyfriend, rejected by her family, who is now gone after a rainy night.
A woman meets her former love, now with someone new, and reflects on how time slips away.

songs.t: The Way You Do the Things You Do
songs.s: A singer praises a lover's charm and says she could have been anything she wanted to be.
A woman says anyone with a heart would love her, begging a lover who keeps hurting her to stay.

songs.t: I Love You More and More Every Day
songs.s: A man says his love for his wife grows every day since their vows, deepening over time.
A man tells a heartbroken listener that the lover has moved on and the relationship is over.
A man forgives a former love who left him, still missing her after she accused him of cheating.
A nonsense bird chant mixed with stage banter, inviting the crowd and dancers onto the floor.

songs.t: What Kind of Fool (Do You Think I Am)
songs.s: A lover demands respect, saying a partner who sees someone else and breaks plans treats them like a fool.

songs.t: The Door Is Still Open to My Heart
songs.s: A man says the door to his heart stays open for a lover who left him lonely.
A man is overwhelmed by a girl who has him so caught up he cannot sleep or think.
A man finds comfort, safety and strength in a lover's arms against a cold, indifferent world.
A man is proud to love a girl who belongs to someone else, and says she loves him too.

songs.t: I Wanna Love Him So Bad
songs.s: A girl longs to love a neighborhood boy named Jim, certain she could make him happy.
A self-deprecating man admits he drank and gambled away the rent while neglecting his family.
A singer calls a lover as sweet as cotton candy and cannot stop gazing at them.

songs.t: (You Don't Know) How Glad I Am
songs.s: A lover says their love has no beginning or end and wishes they could express how glad they are.
A bitter song says people will lie, betray and kill for money, selling their souls for it.
A singer advises guarding your love, since lovers who give it away too freely throw it away.
A night out where the singer urges their partner to dress up and wear high-heel sneakers to dance.
A smitten singer puzzles over how a lover makes them feel, blue and wishing for the secret.
A singer shows off dance moves and asks a lover to join the dancing and admit their love.
A singer says a lover's kisses carry them to a perfect paradise wherever they are together.
A newcomer moves into a haunted house, stands firm against a strange visitor and refuses to leave.
A lover begs a partner to sneak out late at night, past the sleeping parents, to be together.
A young man falls instantly for a girl at a dance and vows never to dance with anyone else.
A jilted man vows to keep waiting for a girl who left him, knowing it is foolish.
A singer begs a lover not to leave or mistreat them, sure that they will stay faithful.
A shy lover confesses again, saying they have loved their sweetheart since forever and can't hide it.
A sailor crosses the sea toward a waiting girl, longing to reach home and her arms.
A singer watches a man they love with another woman, hurting and unable to stop the heartache.

songs.a: Sam the Sham and the Pharaohs
songs.s: Two girls gossip about a horned, woolly monster, then urge everyone to dance along.

songs.t: I Can't Help Myself (Sugar Pie Honey Bunch)
songs.s: A man admits he is helplessly devoted to his sweetheart, unable to resist her or stop loving her.
A protest-minded singer rejects consumer ads and TV pitches, saying no amount of stuff brings contentment.
A troubled man wakes thinking of a lost lover and tries to walk his blues away.
A man mourns that his partner has lost the feeling for him and begs her to bring it back.
Feeling lonely or worried? Head downtown, where the lights and music will lift your spirits and cares.
A singer admits he's insecure, has lost his independence and needs someone to help him feel better.
A smitten singer asks their sweetheart to hear their pounding heart, then plans to marry them.
A singer finds peace and joy in a simple chapel and urges others to bring their troubles there.
A man sings that his girl makes even cloudy days bright and needs no fortune or fame.
A jilted singer begs a friend to help erase a lost love.
A cheerful drifter with no money or possessions rides freight trains and seems content.
A singer playfully offers a gentle lesson about love and nature to a girl.

songs.t: Hold Me, Thrill Me, Kiss Me
songs.s: A singer begs a lover to hold, thrill and kiss them until they confess love.
An energetic call to the dance floor urging listeners to get loose and dance wildly at the party.
A singer declares that money worries and doubts do not matter, since they have each other.
A jilted singer offers a ring that no longer means anything since the breakup.

songs.t: Mrs. Brown, You've Got a Lovely Daughter
songs.s: A jilted man tells a mother not to let on that he is hurt, though he misses her daughter.

songs.t: Stop! In the Name of Love
songs.s: A singer pleads with an unfaithful lover to stop seeing someone else before the heartbreak.
A man longs for his absent lover and asks her to wait for him while missing her.
A man sees his girl's silhouette with another man through a shade, then rushes to win her back.
A singer vows nobody could replace a lover, then the band chats about Australian folk songs.
A singer pleads with their beloved not to say goodbye, promising to love them until the end of time.
A restless narrator begs a musician to play a song that will carry him away into dreams.

songs.t: Cast Your Fate to the Wind
songs.s: A narrator lets wind and tide carry him, with only the empty sky as a friend.
A nervous narrator admits inexperience in love but says they are ready to learn and fall in love.
A playful singer flirts with a lover, praising their features and promising to kiss them.
A protest song warns a skeptical friend that the world is on the brink of destruction.
A singer cheers on a girl from a rough neighborhood, saying he loves her regardless of her father.
A man is heartbroken that the girl he loves is leaving, saying living with him drags her down.

songs.t: Red Roses for a Blue Lady
songs.s: A man orders red roses from a florist to win back his sweetheart after a silly quarrel.

songs.t: Papa's Got a Brand New Bag
songs.s: A father flaunts a new dance style and lively moves, urging everybody to join the party.
A playful singer urges a lover to start romancing right away, invoking the first couple from long ago.
A party game where a singer rhymes everyone's first name into a silly chant the crowd can join.
A singer invites a friend after work to a loud, packed club with great music and low lights.
A singer is thrilled to get back a lover after ignoring friends who warned against them.
Singer vows lasting devotion to a lover, promising loyalty until impossible things happen.
A comic tale of a giant who meets an Amazon woman and gets slapped, told with silly vegetable asides.
Comforting a grieving woman after a dream of her lover's death, promising his love endures beyond death.
A scornful address to a once-wealthy woman now fallen and homeless, asking how it feels.
A declaration of love and a promise to keep saying it, asking whether the listener will believe.
A singer's homage to the river and home place he loves, praising friendly people who welcome anyone.
A man begs his lover to stay, hoping for one lucky break and not to be let down.
A boastful singer claims magical powers over women and fate, calling himself the one seventh son.

songs.t: I'm Henry the Eighth, I Am
songs.s: A comic singer jokes about marrying a widow with seven prior husbands, as her eighth, all called Henry.

songs.t: A Walk in the Black Forest

songs.s: A lover promises to give everything, diamonds and the stars, in exchange for his beloved's love.
A singer praises girls from across America, wishing they all could be from California.
A jilted singer begs a departing lover to leave now, before he breaks down in tears.
A warning to a girl to avoid a cold, greedy man whose gold-obsessed charm hides a kiss of death.
A poor young man from the wrong side of town loves a boss's daughter but isn't welcome.
Nothing stops a man from following his heart; he says he must go wherever love leads, whatever it brings.
A rowdy group dares listeners to catch them as they rush around, yelling at full force.
A singer declares an all-consuming love, saying he needs her always, eight days a week.
A lover leaves with a sad goodbye, admitting their love is over and that the parting hurts.
A dance-floor invitation to a partner to do the jerk, claiming she turns him on and calling it his song.
A man promises to work hard and stay true, but says he'd leave if he found his partner cheating.
A lover allows a partner summer flings, asking only that the heart stay faithful and return.
A lonely singer, now loved, is weary of a partner who keeps him waiting and begs them to stop.
A devoted singer offers to be counted on through thick and thin, insisting they'd be the one loved most.

songs.t: All Day and All of the Night
songs.s: A singer wants his girl all day and night, believing their love will last forever.

songs.t: What the World Needs Now Is Love
songs.s: A plea that the world's greatest need is love for everyone, not more mountains or meadows.
A jealous singer shrugs off common feelings but admits he's in love and hurting when his partner strays.
A man is charmed by a stylish woman who strolls up and asks his name, celebrating her moves.
An instructional dance song urging listeners to move loosely, shake their shoulders and roll with soul.
A self-deprecating singer admits lacking school knowledge but says love alone would make the world wonderful.
A woman admits her lover is bad for her yet cannot escape him, even in her thoughts.
A lonely man, desperate for his absent lover, promises to never make her sad if she returns.
A lovelorn man buys a love potion from a fortune-teller, then kisses everything until a cop breaks his bottle.
A man meets a girl, then learns she died a year ago; his sweater lies on her grave.
A poor, orphaned girl tells her boyfriend she must leave town for the city, promising a return someday.
A singer tells a clinging lover to leave, insisting he isn't the strong protector she wants.
A singer begs a rival to refuse his girlfriend's advances, insisting her love belongs to him.
A lovesick singer falls apart whenever his former girlfriend walks past, and cannot stop thinking about her.

songs.t: Red Roses for a Blue Lady
songs.s: A man sends red roses from a florist to win back his sweetheart after a quarrel, hoping for marriage.
A woman begs her boyfriend to explain what's wrong or end it, rather than leave her hurting.
A man hides heartbreak behind a happy face, admitting other women are mere substitutes for his lost love.
A woman says she misses her lost love, but too many rivers and lost dreams keep them apart.
A singer invites friends to a lively club, where they rock away their blues and shout for more.
A man lists the small gestures his lover makes, like holding hands and whispering, that prove her love.
A couple vows that their true love will bring joy to those who care, through sighs and tears alike.
A singer hears a favorite song from a lost love and aches with memories of dancing and romance.
A singer commiserates with a friend who also lost his girl, each agreeing they both carry troubles.
A warning to men and women: keep hold of a good partner, or someone else will snap them up.

songs.t: We Gotta Get Out of This Place
songs.s: Desperate narrators plead to escape a dreary city where their fathers slave away, dreaming of a better life.
A smug friend mocks a girl who trusted a cheater and now sits lonely, warning her she'll stay single.
A man warns his lover he may leave for good, feeling too much pain and sorrow to stay.
A singer insists music's magic frees the soul and invites a listener to dance through the night.

songs.t: All I Really Want to Do
songs.s: A singer rejects controlling a partner and only wants to be friends with them.
A jealous lover begs to be taken back and promises to stop being possessive.
A giddy admirer craves a sweet, fine girl and dreams of making her his own.
Heartbroken and apologetic, a singer admits faults, still loves his lost partner and hopes for reunion.
Shrugging off mockery for his looks and manner, the singer insists on being himself and loving someone anyway.
Gentle, patient courtship is the advice: treat a lover with care and she will give love back.
Rejected in love, the singer compares losing a woman to a race he lost to a rival.
A man admits he is a fool for a girl who mistreats him and keeps waiting by the phone.

songs.t: The Boy from New York City
songs.s: A smitten girl gushes over a charming, wealthy city boy she met and wants to see again.
Two lovers on the run from disapproving people keep searching for a hiding place together.

songs.t: How Sweet It Is (To Be Loved by You)
songs.s: A grateful singer thanks a lover for the comfort and understanding that lifted him through his troubles.
Stuck in cold grey winter, the singer daydreams of California and dreams of leaving home.
A scorned singer vows his ex will one day be the one left crying, after she mocked him from above.
Walking through heartbreak, a singer searches for someone to care and vows to find peace of mind.
A departing traveler begs a lover to meet him at the station before his train leaves, unsure he will return.
A devoted singer promises a hurting lover constant love and support, urging them to reach out.

songs.t: These Boots Are Made for Walkin'
songs.s: A woman warns a cheating lover that she will walk out and leave him behind for good.
An admirer quietly pines for a woman who will never share his dreams, wishing he could make her see him.
Two strangers exchange glances one night and fall instantly in love, staying together ever since.
A menacing boy with a hidden gun threatens classmates, warning them to run before he comes for them.

songs.t: The Ballad of the Green Berets
songs.s: A tribute to elite Green Beret soldiers, closing with a dead soldier's wife asking that his son follow him.
A playful singer jokes that a doctor cannot cure his ailment, which only good lovin can fix.
Pleading with a leaving lover, the singer says without her he has nothing and cannot go on.
Lonely and impatient, the singer recalls her mother's advice that love cannot be rushed and must be waited for.
Grateful for a lover who turned his rainy days into sunshine, the singer declares his love again and again.
A departing lover says goodbye for the summer, asking to write, and fears losing them to someone else.

songs.a: Sam the Sham and the Pharaohs
songs.s: A wolf in sheep's clothing flirts with a girl in the woods and offers to walk her safely home.
A suitor urges a girl to wait for him, admitting his desire overwhelms him whenever he sees her lips.
A rich man drops a woman, so the singer welcomes her back to the poor side of town.
A worn-out laborer hauls coal every day and longs to sit down, too tired even for weekend fun.
A blissful singer celebrates a close, intimate romance that makes the world feel completely right.

songs.t: You Don't Have to Say You Love Me
songs.s: A woman releases a departed lover, saying he need not stay or love her, while still longing for him.
A playful suitor boasts he can do anything a superhero can and promises to win his sweetheart over.
A woman says womanhood means hurt and sacrifice under a man, yet she is glad to love him anyway.
Every Monday reminds a woman of being left behind by a lover, so she cries on that day.
After a breakup the singer decides the worst is over, feeling free and ready to live without the ex.
Urges the listener to live freely, following their heart and wonder, without walls or fear holding them back.
A man tells a departing lover to walk away and never follow him home, while he grieves alone.
A showoff struts down the street, boasting he is king of the cool jerk and inviting everyone to join.
A woman delights in pet names and a partner's tender affection, spelling out the word baby.
A singer is smitten by a girl standing alone and asks if he can take her home.

songs.t: When a Man Loves a Woman
songs.s: A man in love will give up everything and forgive betrayal, even when his partner treats him badly.
Unable to wait forever for a lover's loyalty, the singer begs to be taken back before time runs out.
A shy romance begins when a man offers a stranger shelter under his umbrella at a rainy bus stop.
Grief-stricken, the singer wants everything painted black, shutting out the sunny world that reminds him of loss.
Hot city streets leave people drained, but the nights bring dancing and a chance to find love.

songs.t: I'm So Lonesome I Could Cry
songs.s: Under a lonely night sky, the singer aches for a missing lover and wants to cry.
A new lover pledges a deep, unchanging love, warmer than sunshine and wider than the sky.
A dreamy boy wanders outdoors on a lazy sunny day, daydreaming about the sweetheart he cannot stop thinking of.
Desperate and humble, the singer pleads with a leaving girl to stay, saying he will beg and bear anything.
A bold, simple declaration of attraction to a wild partner who makes everything feel groovy.
A dreamer chases an elusive, fleeting love through half-remembered dreams and imagined footsteps.
A withdrawn narrator shields himself from love and pain, choosing isolation over feeling anything.
A singer boasts about loving his hometown Boston, its rough crowds and its locked-door curfews.
A jilted man mocks a heartbreaker who toys with men, then cries crocodile tears when she is caught.
A lover senses his partner slipping away and knows the heartbreak of parting is coming soon.
A smitten guy asks a girl at a dance to be his girl after winning her over with sweet words.
A secret agent lives dangerously, warned that trust and careless words can cost him his life.

songs.t: Did You Ever Have to Make Up Your Mind?
songs.s: Choosing between two romantic prospects is hard, and a girl's father settles it with a warning.
A partner pleads to settle an argument before love is lost, since life is too short for fighting.
A touring musician waits in a train station, longing for home where his love is waiting.
A poor man reassures his girl that everything is alright, since love matters more than money or status.

songs.t: Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)
songs.s: A woman recalls her childhood sweetheart shooting her down, then lingers as a ghost calling him back.
Sailors on a drunken shore-leave trip long to go home after a miserable voyage.
A singer scolds a spoiled, troubled girl whose messed-up childhood leads to yet another breakdown.
A would-be novelist pitches his manuscript to a publisher, begging for a break as a paperback writer.
A man learns that kindness and inner qualities matter more than looks, choosing a loving girl over a pretty face.

songs.t: No Matter What Shape (Your Stomach's In)

songs.s: A party invitation to take off your shoes and dance barefoot, as the whole room kicks loose.
A moody lover admits he acts like a fool and begs his girl not to leave him alone to cry.

songs.t: Love Makes the World Go Round
songs.s: Love makes the world turn, bringing joy and tears to everyone from children to lovers.
A piper-like leader urges a hesitant girl to trust him and follow, insisting he knows the way out.
A separated lover hopes to be reunited someday, keeping the dream alive until they meet again.
A man is tempted by a stranger at a bar but resists after glimpsing his own wedding band.
A man asks whether his lover would still marry him if he were a humble tradesman, not a rich one.
A woman warns other girls to stay away from her boyfriend Bill, insisting that he is hers alone.
A guy raves about his exciting girlfriend, whose moves make him feel alive every time she is near.
A woman asks a bluebird to carry word to her absent lover, begging him to come home to her.
Love brings both joy and pain, and the singer keeps loving a partner who could break his heart.
A singer raves about a girl named Gloria who visits at midnight and makes him feel alright.

songs.t: My World Is Empty Without You
songs.s: A lonely singer, abandoned by a lover, finds the house and the world empty and cannot carry on.
A singer calls out to a girl named Barbara Ann over playful doo-wop chants and goofy studio banter.
A sardonic protest song says everyone gets persecuted, but you will not feel alone in it.
A sincere countryman shares his heartfelt poems, identifying with the poor and seeking refuge in nature.
A singer vows to do anything his lover commands, happily acting like a puppet on her strings.
A party-starter calls the crowd onto the dance floor for the Watusi and the Jerk, feeling great.
A devoted partner counts the joy their lover brings, weathering stormy times and feeling happiness overflow.
A hymn praising women as powerful leaders and lovers who shape men, the world and destiny.
A singer declares that nothing compares to his sweetheart, who makes all his dreams come true.
A girl warns herself against a charming, cheating sweet talker, yet still loves him anyway.
A tired worker endures the weekly grind and lives for quitting time and the partner waiting at home.
A jilted lover wants his girl back, feeling blue since she left and fearing she may never return.
A directionless man drifts through a nowhere life, blind to the world and begging to be noticed.
A playboy chases many women, sneaking through back doors while a husband is away, warned his lifestyle will catch up.
A restless singer itches for relief and asks his lover to scratch his back while a harmonica plays.
A smitten guy admires the girl he loves, saying her style and her hair drive him wild.
The more he sees his love, the more devoted and lost he becomes, promising to stay hers forever.
A man doing hard labor reflects that he fought the law and lost, missing his girl and his freedom.
A sailor tells of a sea voyage on a yellow submarine, living happily beneath the waves with his crew.
A restless man craves a sweet life, wealth and a fine girl by his side, willing to bend the rules.

songs.a: Herb Alpert and the Tijuana Brass

songs.s: A young man wonders whether time will make him wiser or send him off to war.
A romantic chase through a lonely man's troubled life, where a woman named Mary promises escape from emptiness.
An invitation to call a phone number for love and comfort whenever someone feels lonely.

songs.t: Devil with a Blue Dress On / Good Golly, Miss Molly
songs.s: A tribute to a glamorous, flamboyant woman who dresses to the nines and parties all night.
Yearning to be older and married, imagining a future when the couple can finally live together.
A heartbroken lover keeps taking back a partner who keeps leaving, pleading for one more chance.
A couple looks forward to summer together, savoring spring sunshine and the season ahead.
A satirical portrait of a smug, conventional man whose respectable life hides vanity and hypocrisy.
A grateful student says farewell to a teacher who guided them from childhood, thanking him for everything.
Rushing home by plane after a letter says a lover could not live without him any longer.
A family dinner-table talk reveals a young man's suicide, while the narrator quietly tosses flowers from a bridge.
A devoted admirer pines for a free-spirited woman everyone knows, unable to win her heart.
A man who had given up on love is suddenly converted by one glimpse of a woman.
A lover urges a partner to ignite their passion and take the night higher without holding back.
A nervous singer rehearses a confession of love, planning to say the words once the evening feels right.
Lovers imagine a future together, insisting they belong as one and nothing can keep them apart.
Spending a lazy Sunday afternoon with a partner, the singers feel the world belongs to them together.

songs.t: Can't Take My Eyes Off You
songs.s: A smitten lover marvels at a beloved's beauty, pledging devotion and hoping the love is real.
Advice that a little soul brings comfort when you feel low, lose your girl, or need a party.
Secret lovers sneak away from disapproving eyes, finally alone together and whispering about their hidden love.
A woman demands respect from her man, insisting he give it when he comes home, and asserting her own worth.

songs.t: I Was Made to Love Her
songs.s: A lifelong devotion to a childhood sweetheart, promising to love and stand by her through everything.

songs.t: Come Back When You Grow Up
songs.s: A singer tells a young girl to come back once she grows up, since her innocence is not ready.
A jilted singer admits his girl cheated but insists he still loves her and will always love her.
A celebration of soul music, calling out star singers one by one and urging everyone to dance.
A romantic chase through rush-hour traffic, with rivals crowding in around the one they all want.
A singer boasts of being a true soul man who works hard for his love and promises to satisfy.
A lover reassures a partner that love will never fade, promising devotion for a lifetime and asking to stay together.
A hide-and-seek game turns into a pursuit of a former playmate who keeps ignoring the singer.

songs.t: Come On Down to My Boat
songs.s: A man invites a fisherman's daughter to sail away with him in his little red boat, promising fun.
A psychedelic-tinged plea to look inward, question our games and drop the divisions in a confused world.
