A farewell to a free-spirited woman who never stays anywhere, mourning the loss while she keeps changing.
A woman plays it cool after a breakup, but every ringing phone sends her hoping it's the one who left.

songs.t: Love Is Here and Now You're Gone
songs.s: A heartbroken lover recalls being persuaded into love, only to be abandoned and left in lonely pain.
A warning that a tense crowd and armed men signal danger, urging everyone to stop and look.
A man asks his girlfriend for a clear sign of her love, so he knows whether she wants him.
Suddenly losing a lover changes everything, leaving the narrator broken, shaken and awake to life's hard truths.
A universal anthem declaring love is all anyone needs, insisting that nothing is impossible when love guides you.
A lover begs to be released from a dead relationship so they can love again with someone new.
A grateful singer credits a beloved partner for bringing joy and purpose, feeling like heaven sent them.
A frantic cry for someone to love, with chaos, false friendship, and tears pushing the narrator to find love fast.
A dancer begs his partner not to sit down, insisting they keep dancing the boogaloo and other steps all night.
A nostalgic singer remembers carefree childhood days with a brown-eyed girl by the water and in the green grass.
A woman pines for her absent boyfriend, begging him to come back as another suitor keeps calling her.
A cheerful singer lists the joys of rhythm, music and a girl, saying nothing else could ask for more.
A hazy, dreamlike party story about a mysterious woman who leaves the narrator bewildered.
A hurt lover asks why his partner lies and runs around, begging her to care about his pain again.

songs.t: Then You Can Tell Me Goodbye
songs.s: A lover asks for a lifetime of devotion and accepts an ending if the relationship must go, if told first.
A woman looks back at past reflections, mourning a lost love and the faith she placed in a departed partner.
A singer rides a carousel, chasing a girl who keeps slipping away until the chance to catch her comes.
A devoted singer pleads for a lover's eternal affection, promising to wait even after death and never forget them.
A man questions what life means and concludes that love is what makes it worthwhile.
Narrator watches a friend's partner deceive her and debates whether to speak up or keep quiet.
A man watches his sleeping lover and says his cup overflows with love in every quiet moment.
An invitation to float away in a balloon above the world, sailing the sky with a lover.

songs.t: San Francisco (Be Sure to Wear Flowers in Your Hair)
songs.s: Visitors heading to San Francisco are urged to wear flowers, promising gentle people and a summer of love.

songs.t: The Rain, the Park & Other Things
songs.s: A man falls for a girl with flowers in her hair he meets in the rain, then she vanishes.
Across the world lovers hush and whisper their devotion, promising forever love to one another.
A man praises his girl as the best thing in his life and begs for mercy, since she leaves him weak.
A singer says that since meeting her beloved, the whole world feels bright and she offers a song of devotion.

songs.t: (Your Love Keeps Lifting Me) Higher and Higher
songs.s: A man says his lover's devotion lifts him higher than ever, leaving his past sorrows behind.
After a long stretch of loneliness, the narrator finds someone who makes him feel free and happy.
Recollections of a suburban street in Liverpool, its barber, banker, fireman and nurse, all remembered fondly.
A singer says his beloved changed his dull life and is now everything, the center of his world.
A singer urges a lonely, shy girl to shed her drab habits and let the bolder person inside shine.
A telegram announces a breakup, and the singer decides to move on and find someone else.
A woman tells her lover she loves him, promising to keep him from leaving and fully giving herself to him.

songs.t: A Little Bit Me, a Little Bit You
songs.s: A man begs his girl not to walk out, admitting both are a little wrong and asking her to stay.
A singer loves walking the shore with her lover on California nights and chooses to stay there.

songs.t: Dedicated to the One I Love
songs.s: A distant lover is asked to pray each night, and the singer dedicates the song to the one they love.
A man in a changing world asks how he can be sure of where he stands with his lover.
A narrator recalls a school friend he once admired, now lost to older boys and wondering where her magic went.
Life is up and down, but a band vows to keep going, since they have made mistakes and still have what it takes.
A worker drags through the week, dreaming of Friday night out in the city with his girl.
A band announces a sixty-second dance number, shouting encouragement to dance and get down.
A singer's temperature rises at a crowded party, and he and his partners celebrate getting plenty of loving.

songs.t: Let It Out (Let It All Hang Out)
songs.s: A mock sermon of drinking, smoking and sleepless nights ends by urging listeners to stop holding back and let it all out.
Worries and rushing to chase money are rejected; the singer prefers living for today with a lover.
A singer begs a lover to stay present and look at her, admitting she has cried over him and wants to be real.
A shouted tour of Broadway names its streets, clubs, crowds and dances, and celebrates the funky street life.
Suburban Sundays feel monotonous, with lawns, identical houses and mothers' complaints, and the singer longs for change.

songs.t: I Never Loved a Man (The Way I Love You)
songs.s: A woman admits she keeps taking back a cheating lover, though friends warn her he is no good.
A man tells a woman he is not a toy to play with and asks her to be honest and love him for real.
A singer says he does not care about her past and wants love to last, asking to be held and understood.
A man boasts that his girl is happier with him than with the other men who chase around, and he is lucky.
A man greets the sunny morning, crediting his girl with a new lift, and says her love is the medicine that saved him.
A man knows his lover will break his heart again, yet he takes her back and plays the fool once more.
Alice in Wonderland imagery becomes a call to take a pill or mushroom and expand the mind.
A man tells Bernadette that other men envy his love for her, and that she belongs to him alone.
Drums keep pounding as fashions, history and everyday life roll on, from the Charleston to teen idols.
A beagle pilot named Snoopy takes on the Red Baron in a dogfight and shoots him down.
A girl's mother, teachers and society forbid her from seeing a Black boy, and she accepts it for now.

songs.t: Girl, You'll Be a Woman Soon
songs.s: A young man urges his girl to come to him as she grows up, despite others calling him no good for her.
A singer promises to reach his lover across any mountain, valley or river whenever she calls.
A partner takes back hurtful words and apologizes, then decides she must say goodbye anyway.
A man watches his partner walk off with another guy and admits she can never be his, however hard he tries.
A man returns to a lost love and promises a lasting bond that other love cannot match.

songs.t: I Dig Rock and Roll Music
songs.s: A singer loves rock and roll and name-checks bands like the Mamas and Papas, Donovan and the Beatles, doubting their messages.

songs.t: I Had Too Much to Dream (Last Night)
songs.s: A man dreams of a lost lover who visits him at night, then wakes alone in an empty room.
A dreamer wakes to a dull routine and tells his girl to cheer up, since love is all they really need.
A lonely man begs for his lover's affection, saying he cannot go on without her and feels weak for needing it.
A man keeps seeing his lost lover in familiar places, knowing she is gone for good.
A prisoner dreams of walking home to family and a sweetheart, then wakes to his cell.
A spurned lover says he sees through the cheating and will expose it, defiant and bitter.
A singer urges a partner who walked out to come back and make up after their quarrel.

songs.t: Thank the Lord for the Night Time
songs.s: Work drudgery ends at dusk when the singer reunites with his girl to relax and groove together.
A singer urges a friend to open his heart to love and stop carrying his troubles alone.
A heartbroken singer sees the colors of life fade after a lover leaves, leaving only grey and blue.
A widower remembers his late wife Honey through small everyday moments and misses her badly.

songs.t: (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay
songs.s: A man idles on a dock far from home, watching the tide and feeling aimless and lonely.
A call for peace and equal freedom for everyone, urging people to live together and look out for each other.
A lover longs to reach their beloved at dawn and stay together through the rest of life.

songs.t: This Guy's in Love with You
songs.s: A man confesses he loves a woman who may not know it, and begs her to say whether she feels the same.

songs.t: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly

songs.s: A satirical toast to a bored suburban housewife, mixing a mock prayer with jabs at society and its hypocrisies.
A dance call from Houston asking the band and the crowd to tighten up the groove, instrument by instrument.
A widowed mother stands up to a hypocritical PTA that scolded her, calling out their own scandals.
A husband says his devoted wife's love means more to him than anything else in the world.
A party chant about feeling great and dancing with a crowd, shouting the name over and over.
A man is smitten by a striking woman walking the street and asks for her name, hoping to win her over.
A man admits he fell for a much younger girl, asks what to do, and braces for harsh judgment from others.
A jilted singer admits he is heartbroken and cries like a baby over a love that ended.
An invitation to a dreamy, joyful picnic full of sunshine, music, wine and honey, with sweet imagery throughout.
A relaxed call to lie in the sun, enjoy nature and notice the colorful world around you.
A lovesick person secretly tells the world they love someone who belongs to another, wishing they could say it aloud.
A pulsing band call to dance, introducing each musician in turn and telling the squares to go home.
A heartbroken man stays indoors wishing for rain to hide his tears after his girl left him for another.
A singer without a ring or a song pleads with a girl to believe his sincere love and let him try.
A singer urges a lover to turn around and notice the person who truly loves and will guide them.
A playful, surreal song about a girl hiding behind glasses, ending with a bitter jab at her for the trouble.
A man teases a playful girl who keeps him guessing, promising to propose on Halloween if she stops the game.
A child born in poverty to an unwed mother pleads for love and worth despite the shame and stigma she carries.
A woman accepts a fleeting night with a lover and asks him to leave at dawn without begging him to stay.

songs.t: The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde
songs.s: A narrated ballad about two outlaws who robbed banks, were hunted by lawmen, and were killed in an ambush.
A woman revisits an old tavern, remembering youthful friends and seeing how much she has changed since then.
A rebel call to rev the engine, hit the highway for adventure and live wild and free.
A grown man recalls childhood play giving way to romance, as his former playmate moves from dolls to boys.
A bouncy children's game song where listeners follow Simple Simon's commands, lifting hands and turning left and right.
A man pleads with a hesitant woman to give him her love now, promising tender care in return.
A cheerful singer steps outside on a sunny morning, urging everyone to shake off the blues and seize the day.
A couple celebrates their passionate romance and travels, saying a loving look says more than words could.
A man begs his partner to drop the fights, forgive him and hold him tight, admitting he was a fool.
A bubbly singer says love fills her up and her sweetheart is good enough to eat, playfully expressing affection.

songs.a: The Crazy World of Arthur Brown
songs.s: A fiery, apocalyptic warning that a blind, self-absorbed person will burn away and must face their own destruction.
A man warns a friend that a flirtatious small-town girl will break his heart, urging him to run before it is too late.
A singer accuses her boyfriend of playing around, begging him to be honest and fearing he will leave her lonely.
A woman feels stuck on a merry-go-round, questioning how she got here and when she will finally know who she is.
A man begs a woman to slip away from her partner for a secret meeting, hiding their affair from others.
A cheerful boy boasts about watching girls walk by and flirts with one passing girl, asking her to stroll closer.

songs.t: (Sweet Sweet Baby) Since You've Been Gone
songs.s: A woman mourns her departed lover, asking him to come back and promising loyalty if he returns to her.
A street musician asks passersby for spare coins, promising to play any song for anyone who chips in.
A singer keeps trying to prove his love, but his partner keeps stopping him and he says he is right.
A friendly call to reach out through hard times and connect with others.
A defiant rock anthem about a rough childhood and a rebel's pride.
A lost lover's cake metaphor leads to a bitter reflection on a shattered romance.
A flirtatious plea to set the night on fire and chase a shared high.
A tongue-tied singer struggles to say I love you and feels held back.
A man ignores his mother's warning to slow down and learns his fiancee cheated.
A haunted narrator sees a lover's face everywhere and cannot shake the image.
A worker fumes about low pay, a summer with no money and a dismissive boss.

songs.t: Ain't Nothing Like the Real Thing
songs.s: A singer insists a photo or letter cannot replace the real person they love.
A bouncy celebration of a feeling that rises and falls with love and mood.

songs.t: I've Gotta Get a Message to You
songs.s: A condemned man begs a preacher to deliver a farewell message to the woman he wronged.
A sympathetic portrait of a struggling mother juggling children, rent and hard days.
A dreamy vision of a wandering singer who brings songs of love by the sea.
A dreamer invites a girl on a magic carpet ride of fantasy and escape.
A drunk pleads to be allowed home and to start over after another binge.
A plea to a lover to stay close and keep loving the narrator.
A jealous man confronts a woman who betrayed him and loses control in a fatal rage.
A cocky dance boast claiming nobody can perform the moves like the singer.
A soul singer thanks a lover for the affection and passion received.
A reflection on a solitary man on a hill whom others dismiss as a fool.
A chaplain blesses young soldiers who march into battle and many who will die.
A jingle inviting families to a lake town with canoes, coves and summer fun.

songs.t: I Wonder What She's Doing Tonight
songs.s: A lovesick singer wonders what a former partner is doing tonight.
A heartbroken narrator cannot stop thinking about a former lover.

songs.t: Goin' Out of My Head / Can't Take My Eyes Off You
songs.s: A medley of two love songs about being wild over a sweetheart.
A singer vows to win over a cheating man's partner and claim her heart.
A Noah's ark tale in which the unicorns are left behind and never seen again.
A woman begs an ex to set her free because he will not really let go.
A song that wants change but refuses destruction and calls for patience.
A worried lover accuses a woman of wanting to cheat and sees it in her looks.
A giddy love song to a girl the narrator adores despite her family.
A lonely narrator in a dim room mourns a lover who left by train.

songs.t: You're All I Need to Get By
songs.s: A devoted lover pledges loyalty and promises to be there in every need.

songs.t: Baby, Now That I've Found You
songs.s: A man begs a lover not to leave, promising to build his world around her.
A singer says a lover's sweet words are the inspiration that keeps going.
A lover promises to stay near whenever the other needs him, through wanting and caring.
A man in a cab begs the driver to pass his lost love's home one more time.
A call to young people to take their own path as the time has come.

songs.t: Do You Know the Way to San Jose
songs.s: A lost traveler asks the way to a hometown seeking peace and a fresh start.
A traveler asks someone to remember a lost love and a list of impossible tasks.

songs.t: Say It Loud – I'm Black and I'm Proud
songs.s: An anthem declaring pride in being Black and refusing to live on one's knees.
A playful song about a mysterious figure who will sort out everyone's chaos.
A playful courtroom comedy where a judge sets the rules for dancing and fun.
A woman's morning and workday are full of silent prayers for her loved one.
A forceful demand that the listener think and stop playing games with a partner.
A summer parting promise to send love by letter, sealed with a kiss.

songs.a: Big Brother and the Holding Company
songs.s: A defiant lover says she will keep giving her heart despite the pain.
A simple love song praising a girl's walk and talk and her faithfulness.
A lover willingly lets a partner shape her however they like if they love her.
A man begs a telegram messenger to deliver a longing message to his girl.
A man vows to stay loyal to a lover who mistreats him, while warning her she is hurting him.
