songs.s: A father leaving his family turns back when his daughter chases after him, begging him to slow down and stay.
A devoted singer begs a partner to stay together through every good and bad time.
A harbor-town waitress keeps loving a sailor who always leaves, faithful to the sea he chose over her.
A man who depends on his partner begs her not to leave, admitting he cannot find love anywhere else.
A smitten singer celebrates how good it feels to be with a partner who makes them happy.
A comic rocker recalls childhood mischief and grown-up tomfoolery, with a crude double-entendre chorus repeated throughout.

songs.t: (If Loving You Is Wrong) I Don't Want to Be Right
songs.s: A married man defends his secret affair, saying he would rather be wrong than lose the one he loves.
A restless traveler searches the world for a heart of gold, feeling himself grow older along the way.
A smitten singer promises lasting loyalty to the one they have been waiting for, forever.
A gospel-soul singer invites listeners to a joyful place with no crying, worry or falsehood, and offers to lead them there.
A singer comforts a lonely, rejected friend, promising acceptance and a place to belong.
A soothing lullaby tells a child that the lion sleeps peacefully through the quiet jungle and village night.
A man spirals into despair after his friend is taken away, drinking and reflecting on loss and family.

songs.t: Long Cool Woman in a Black Dress
songs.s: A man on a bootlegging stakeout falls for a tall singer in a black dress just as a raid breaks out.
A lovelorn singer tries to win back a former partner with a playful, hook-driven plan to rekindle what they had.
A singer insists even a blue song can lift you, and invites everyone to sing the blues away together.
A traveler crosses a desert on a horse with no name, then finds the sand turned to sea and life beneath it.
A friend advises a heartbroken listener that everyone plays the fool at times, so don't let heartbreak consume them.
A singer treasures the rare moments with a lover and worries about being far from them and home.

songs.t: (Last Night) I Didn't Get to Sleep at All
songs.s: Sleepless after thinking about a former partner, a singer struggles to move on from dreams that still feel too real.
A lovesick narrator writes unsent letters and reflects on loneliness and the illusions of city life.
A smitten narrator is swept up by a partner who begs for closeness and asks them to go further tonight.

songs.t: Too Late to Turn Back Now
songs.s: A man realizes he has fallen for a woman he calls often, unsure whether she feels the same, and cannot turn back.
A man warns that smiling friends are plotting to steal his lover, aiming knives at his back.
An invitation to join a laid-back party down by the river, where everyone is welcome to come along and sing.
A singer defies a controlling man who tries to run their life, then looks ahead to brighter days.
A man receives a telegram that his ex still loves him, and they agree to rebuild their relationship slowly.
A lonely singer waits day after day, longing for a loved one to come back home soon.
An astronaut on a long lonely mission misses his wife and feels out of place in the life he left behind.
Birds gather in the treetops to rock and dance all night, with a robin leading the party on the street.
A joyful singer spends a sunny Sunday driving with their beloved and celebrates how good it feels.
A hymn praising God for the fresh new morning, the birdsong and the wet garden at dawn.
A southbound overnight train carries the singer past passengers, card games, farms and fading rail life.
A former star goes to a reunion party, finds no one recognizes him, and decides to play only for himself.
After a hard time, the singer feels the pain and darkness lift and sees a bright, sunny future ahead.
An overheated lover praises a partner whose kisses set him on fire, feeling like he is burning with desire.
A woman warns others about a rival who stole her man while she neglected him, and how to avoid it.
A supportive voice urges a woman to hold her head high, ignore the stares and shouts, and keep moving with confidence.
A short Spanish chant of fever-themed exclamations and dance calls, with few real words and no story.
A grieving singer would give up everything they own to have a lost loved one back again.
A heartbroken singer wants to run out into the rain to hide their tears from a lover who has left them.

songs.t: Look What You Done for Me
songs.s: A grateful singer thanks a partner for setting their heart free and admits to past wrongs they are trying to fix.

songs.t: The Happiest Girl in the Whole U.S.A.
songs.s: A woman happily describes her cheerful morning routine with her partner and feels like the happiest woman in the country.
A glam-rock call to a dirty, sweet, car-like lover, built on a chanted hook and a simple chorus.
A mournful but hopeful reassurance that a long-lost family reunion is only a short step away.
A heartbroken plea asking why a lover pretended to leave someone else and then lied about it.

songs.t: I'm Still in Love with You
songs.s: A devoted singer insists he is still deeply in love and wrapped up in his partner's love.
A desperate lover begs a woman who keeps running from her relationship to ease his worried mind.
A woman daydreams about an ideal lover who wants to run away with her and meet her every need.
A warning that loving someone who does not love you back leads to heartbreak and woe.
A simple chant for racial equality, imagining black and white children growing up together in harmony.
A man pleads with a mother over a pay phone to let him say goodbye to the woman who is leaving him.
A couple keeps hurting each other without knowing why and begs to stop breaking each other's hearts.
A silly comic story about a coconut drink with lime and a doctor who is told to call in the morning.
A teenager insists his young love is real and begs others to stop dismissing it as puppy love.

songs.t: You Don't Mess Around with Jim
songs.s: A bully pool hustler named Jim gets cut down by a young challenger from Alabama after a grudge.

songs.a: Commander Cody and His Lost Planet Airmen
songs.s: A reckless young driver races a souped-up Ford down a highway, gets caught by police, and is bailed out by his father.

songs.t: A Cowboy's Work Is Never Done
songs.s: A grown-up remembers a tomboy cowboy childhood and reflects that adult life has lost its fun.
A singer savors the good days with a lover while worrying the future may pull them apart.
A playful, rambling list of places the singer has never visited, joking about being born in Oklahoma.
A man credits his happiness to kissing his partner goodbye each morning and loving her when he gets home.
A rowdy anthem celebrating the end of school, mocking teachers, rules and education.
A joyful, dreamy picture of a Fourth of July afternoon in the park with dancing, ice cream and music.

songs.t: Drowning in the Sea of Love
songs.s: A man feels he is drowning after a lover deserted him and begs to be heard and understood.
A furious, profane rant at a manipulative person who uses people and feels no guilt, promising they will pay.
A bleak portrait of a family strained by divided loyalties, a troubled marriage and fraying bonds.
A spoken comedy routine about a caveman who grabs a woman by the lake and jokes about the encounter.

songs.t: The Witch Queen of New Orleans
songs.s: A spooky tale of Marie, a voodoo witch queen in New Orleans who casts spells from her swamp shack.
A reflective song mourning a young man lost to heroin addiction and urging listeners to avoid his fate.
A man rejoices that his partner's kiss, walk and talk give him power and end his loneliness.
A couple takes turns thanking each other for understanding a breakup and staying kind about it.
A live comic medley: a mock singing contest, then a cabbie's memory of driving his old flame home.
A heartbroken lover pleads with a partner not to pretend they forgot the love they once shared.
A couple parts for the summer, promising daily love letters sealed with a kiss until they meet again in September.
A man realizes his feelings for a longtime partner, admits he used to run away, and promises he will not anymore.
A rider invites a young woman to leave home and see the world on his Harley as his motorcycle partner.
A prayer asking the Lord each day to see him more clearly, love him more dearly and follow him more nearly.
A surreal, cosmic love poem about driving through a valley beneath mountains and eagles while promising to be there.
A man asks a doctor whether he looked at the world too long, having seen its fears and evils without crying.

songs.t: I'd Like to Teach the World to Sing (In Perfect Harmony)
songs.s: A hopeful wish to build the world a home and teach everyone to sing together in peace and harmony.
A tribute to the painter Vincent van Gogh, imagining his beauty and tragic suffering and how the world never understood him.

songs.t: Baby Let Me Take You (In My Arms)
songs.s: A smooth love song asking a partner to let him hold and kiss her, feeling their souls connect.
A man says talking to the sky or the Lord helps him feel better when things go wrong and he feels lost.

songs.t: I'd Like to Teach the World to Sing (In Perfect Harmony)
songs.s: A hopeful wish to build the world a home and teach everyone to sing together in peace and harmony.

songs.t: Walkin' in the Rain with the One I Love
songs.s: A woman happily walks in the rain thinking of her man, then calls him to say she loves him.
A funky party call inviting everyone to dance on the good foot, with a verse about rent and bills.
A playful dance-floor call urging a woman to pop her thing and do her own move, with cheerful call and response.

songs.t: Tie a Yellow Ribbon Round the Ole Oak Tree
songs.s: A man coming home from prison asks his love to tie a yellow ribbon on the oak tree if she still wants him.
A boastful tale of a flashy, dangerous Chicago gambler who fights a jealous man over a woman and gets beaten badly.

songs.t: Killing Me Softly with His Song
songs.s: A woman is moved to tears as a singer performs a song that seems to tell her whole story and expose her pain.
A sultry call to lovers to stop waiting and make love, with a chorus that repeats hot love.
Singer says a lover's devotion sustains them through every hardship, and never has to be questioned.
A repentant plea to Jesus from someone who wasted his blessings and asks for help returning.
Nostalgia for the early rock dances and a lost girl after the fun faded and she left.

songs.t: Will It Go Round in Circles
songs.s: Playful, open-ended musings about a song with no melody, a story with no moral, and a dance with no steps.
A bitter takedown of a vain ex-lover who assumes every song is about him.
A woman asks a departing lover for one more night before a painful, final goodbye.

songs.t: The Night the Lights Went Out in Georgia
songs.s: A man is wrongly hanged for a killing, and his sister reveals that she was the one who did it.
A man escapes a bleak world into a childhood playground fantasy of simple joy and a future family.
A lover pleads with a woman to leave her cheating partner and choose him instead.
A woman still waits in town for a married man who promised to marry her and never came.
Two lovers in a secret affair meet at the same cafe, knowing it is wrong but unable to stop.
Comic, sexually explicit recollections of teenage romps, from backseat fumbles to a high school dance.
A weary listener begs a band to free his soul through rock and roll and escape his troubles.
A party-loving boy who refuses to go home, dancing and charming his way through every crowd.

songs.t: You Are the Sunshine of My Life
songs.s: A tender love song calling a beloved the sunshine and apple of the singer's eye.
A woman of mixed heritage describes rejection by both sides and a lifelong shame of being called a half-breed.
Lustful admiration for an unattainable woman who teases the singer with look but do not touch.
A bold invitation to a lover, claiming her pillow talk beats anything her friends might say.
A rock band brags about road life, partying with fans and women, and tearing up a hotel.
A bemused man lists his missteps and bad timing, wondering why he keeps ending up in the wrong place.
A protective ode to a fragile, hurt woman, urging gentleness and letting her rest and be free.
A lively warning that believing in superstitions and omens brings suffering, so trust in reality instead.
A man reflects on his mother's unconditional love, set against temptation, church and political ambition.
A lover urges a partner to hold on through the night, trusting a brighter morning will come.
A man finds peace and wonder in the Colorado mountains, joyfully at one with nature and friends.

songs.t: Stuck in the Middle with You
songs.s: Anxious unease at a party, surrounded by clowns and jokers, feeling stuck and out of place.
A dreamy call to a peaceful mythical place where kindness and rain wash away pain and shame.
A call for people around the world to join hands and ride a train of love and peace.

songs.t: I'm Gonna Love You Just a Little More Baby
songs.s: A sensual, romantic promise to a lover to keep loving more and more, every day, in every way.

songs.t: Say, Has Anybody Seen My Sweet Gypsy Rose
songs.s: A husband searches for his wife, who left their home to join a burlesque show in New Orleans.
A lover drives toward his beloved with fevered desire, vowing to keep moving through every obstacle.
A mother-to-be, poor but deeply in love, expects a son and trusts that everything will be all right.
A joyous party of friends dancing under the moon, free from worry and full of fun.
Monsters throw a graveyard party and dance the Monster Mash, which becomes the hit of the land.
A smitten singer keeps thinking of someone he hardly knows, promising to love them forever.
A singer praises a radiant partner he is glad to have found, shining like a precious stone.
A lover says life means nothing without love, using long trains running on through the night as the image.

songs.t: Give Me Love (Give Me Peace on Earth)
songs.s: A prayer for love, peace, light and hope, asking God to help carry a heavy load.

songs.t: If You Want Me to Stay
songs.s: A man warns his partner he will not be taken for granted and will leave for a while if she keeps taking him for granted.
A father returns to his lover after a long absence, promising to stay and be there for her.

songs.t: Neither One of Us (Wants to Be the First to Say Goodbye)
songs.s: A couple clings to a failing relationship, each unwilling to be the first to say goodbye.
A man insists he is doing fine after a breakup, telling his former lover he is better off without her.

songs.t: Could It Be I'm Falling in Love
songs.s: A nervous singer wonders whether he is falling in love with someone who makes him feel strange and happy.
A singer mourns his brother who flew off to Spain, longing for him and admiring his strength despite his blindness.
A man who failed in Los Angeles heads home to Georgia on a midnight train, and his lover goes with him.
A band recounts how a fire at a Swiss lakeside casino forced them to find another place to record.
Rock stars joke about wanting their picture on the cover of Rolling Stone while living a drug-fueled, glamorous life.
A proud man describes his lady, who is always poised in public and still sweet behind closed doors.
Young people defy parents who will not dance or rock and roll, spending a night out dancing and getting pulled over.
After love has faded, a couple parts ways and the narrator feels stronger every day.
Storytelling tribute to a swaggering outlaw friend who rides in blasting and chases a gringo through a field.
A warning that a changing world can push people to give in and turn cruel, with a call to resist.

songs.t: Oh, Babe, What Would You Say?
songs.s: A shy suitor wonders whether his crush would welcome his advances, dreaming of a romance that might bloom.

songs.t: I Believe in You (You Believe in Me)
songs.s: A singer affirms mutual trust with his partner and says their bond holds firm against outside doubters.
An uplifting call to sing freely and joyfully about good things, without worrying whether it sounds good enough.

songs.t: Ain't No Woman (Like the One I've Got)
songs.s: A man praises his partner as irreplaceable and devoted, saying he feels lost and lonely whenever she is gone.
A call to keep learning, believing and striving upward despite a broken world, with faith that a better life is near.

songs.t: Here I Am (Come and Take Me)
songs.s: A lovestruck singer begs a partner to come and take him, feeling needy, hurt and emotionally unsettled.
A traveler sings of his devotion to Maria, who lifts his blues and sets his soul free.
A portrait of a street hustler chasing fast money, warning that his high-risk game ends in ruin and loneliness.
A jilted lover writes a final song after long waiting and wondering, realizing the partner is gone for good.
A bemused singer tells a rowdy, teasing partner to calm down, admitting he still wants her around.
A cynical narrator scolds a self-important ex for wasting time and chasing worthless things, asking about the cost.
Nostalgic singer recalls childhood radio songs that brought happy memories, fondly but with a touch of sadness.
A jaunty tale of a trumpeter drafted into the army, whose boogie bugling keeps his whole company jumping.
An uncle sings to a young niece with affectionate teasing, bedtime banter and a playful marriage joke.
A fatalistic narrator describes a gambler stuck in a cycle of crime, betrayal and Vegas losses that keeps repeating.
A nostalgic yet playful ode to vivid color film and photography, pleading that his mother not take the camera away.
A plea for unity and peace, asking why people of every color cannot live together as brothers.
A flirtatious invitation to dance under the moonlight, asking a lover whether they want to dance together all night.
A heartbroken lover accepts a partner's departure, saying he still loves her but cannot bear to hold on.

songs.t: Rockin' Pneumonia and the Boogie Woogie Flu
songs.s: A giddy, tongue-in-cheek narrator describes being overcome by rhythm and nervous shyness on the dance floor.
A wandering narrator says he was born on the road, living restlessly and moving from place to place.
A grim portrait of inner-city life where poverty, crime and drugs wear people down, yet dignity survives.
A reflective narrator finds quiet peace away from others' judgment, remembering old friends, a son and past hopes.
A singer reflects on a love affair that hurt him when his partner left, insisting that real love still matters.
A devoted singer tells a partner that their sweet words and love carry them through hard times.
A spoken-word bit about a funky worm who plays guitar and gets everyone dancing before slipping back into his hole.
A wistful goodbye to a lover, lamenting bleak times with no money or love and asking whether it is time to part.
A cheerful narrator heads by pirogue to a bayou gathering full of food, guitar playing and kin.

songs.t: Don't Expect Me to Be Your Friend
songs.s: A jilted lover says he loves his ex too much to stay friends and asks her not to expect friendship.
A frustrated partner complains that their on-and-off relationship keeps cycling between love and hate.
A tender story of a couple whose lasting love shows in a daily flower gesture and fond memories of their courtship.
An invitation to stir things up with a darling, promising warmth, satisfaction and sweetness in a shared love.
A cynical narrator says money now buys everything, but it has cost him friends, love and any real sense of meaning.
A restless wanderer who never stays in one place seeks a new world and a companion to make a home with.
A weary chorus searches for a paradise home, insisting that for everyone the whole world feels like a ghetto.
A call for people to unite, treat each other as brothers and sisters, and work together to improve the world.
A confident invitation to take a free ride and find the answers within, after confusion and a failing system.
An astronaut drifts in space, cut off from mission control and aware of Earth's distance, and says a final goodbye.

songs.t: It Never Rains in Southern California
songs.s: A newcomer who moved west chasing big dreams admits the promises were empty and wants to go home.
A lover promises unending devotion, asking to be held close and vowing love until an impossible day arrives.
A son learns his absent father led a wandering, dishonest life, and his mother answers with a grim verdict.
A wistful look back at a past relationship, remembering its laughter and wishing the couple could recapture it.
A dying narrator says goodbye to friends, family and loved ones, recalling shared joy and life's fleeting seasons.
A woman asks the band to play their love song again so her partner feels the way he did before.
A self-assured invitation for a partner to come and take the love on offer, with a suggestive, boastful swagger.
A celebration of a woman who dances tirelessly, catching every eye and moving to each beat with bold, flashy energy.
A catchy call for everyone to join a simple group dance that lifts spirits and gets people moving together.
A chanted call for everyone to get up and dance together, with a message of worldwide unity.
A comic mock news report about a man who runs naked through public places, with a sung chorus.
A flamboyant fantasy about a glittering performer, fame and a stage band, delivered in a wild tone.
A man praising a young, free-spirited woman who makes him feel like a real man.

songs.t: Until You Come Back to Me (That's What I'm Gonna Do)
songs.s: A woman begs a man who has left her to come back, promising to keep trying until he does.
A call-and-response dance chant urging listeners to get down and feel the funk.
An invitation to a romantic night in the desert, with playful talk of sharing the evening together.

songs.t: You Make Me Feel Brand New
songs.s: A grateful love ballad thanking a partner who restored the singer's confidence and sense of self.
A singer pleads for his lover to show her feelings and say she loves him back.
A comic memory of a schoolboy romance in which a girl rejects his silly gestures and wants real affection.
An energetic rock tribute to 1950s rock and roll, its idols and a daydream about a movie star.
A happy celebration of sunshine and nature, joking that sunshine almost always gets the singer high.
A carnival-style pitch for a sad show of heartbreak, where every visitor is guaranteed to cry.
Giddy infatuation with a lover who leaves the singer intoxicated and certain of her affection.
A fiancee pleads with her soldier to stay safe, but he volunteers for danger and she is left grieving.
Prisoners plan an escape and become a band on the run, dodging a jailer and a pursuing judge.
A man regrets a fight that drove his beloved away and asks strangers to pass on his apology.
A wish to stop time and spend every day with a loved one, treasuring each moment forever.
A devoted love song comparing a lover's effect on the singer to the wonders of nature.
A promise to always be there for a loved one through every change and hardship.
A jealous narrator warns a rival to stay away, suspecting a partner of cheating while drinking heavily.
A woman celebrates her partner's child growing inside her, glad to share the love and the news.
A tender request to be rocked gently and loved slowly, celebrating a new romance together.
A dance-floor invitation to boogie and make love with a partner through the night.
An adoring singer declares his love for a sixteen-year-old he met and wants her all to himself.

songs.t: If You Love Me (Let Me Know)
songs.s: A lover pleads for a clear answer on whether the other loves them, unable to bear the uncertainty.
A woman visits a fortune teller who exposes her lover's betrayal, and she takes deadly revenge.

songs.t: Best Thing That Ever Happened to Me
songs.s: A singer says life's hard times were few because a partner has been the best thing that ever happened.
A couple strolling through the changing seasons who want to make love and make their dreams come true.

songs.t: Just Don't Want to Be Lonely
songs.s: A singer accepts partings but dreads being alone, wanting a partner who gives the love he lacks.
A proud man insists he brings real value to a relationship and refuses to be an empty pose.
A man urges his lover to hold him close and rock him gently, a simple invitation to intimacy.
A giddy singer feels on top of the world, with love making everything around them seem wondrous.
A boastful, playful persona who wears many nicknames, flirts, and admits to a late-night smoke.

songs.t: I've Got to Use My Imagination
songs.s: A jilted singer, lost in darkness and isolation, forces himself to keep going by using his imagination.
An entertainer feels used and worn out by fame and a hostile crowd, but keeps performing anyway.
A love-as-voyage song that urges a partner not to rock the steady course of their relationship.
A teen recounts sneaking smokes in the school restroom to dodge classes and the teacher's rules.
Poverty, racism and police injustice hit a Black family from Mississippi and their son in New York.
A singer describes how love entered their life for the first time and changed everything.
A child recalls the night a gang war with police tore through Chicago and his father came home safe.
An entertainer is told to hide his heartbreak and perform cheerfully so the audience never knows.
A singer surrenders in love, calling defeat a victory and promising to stay with the beloved forever.
A lover feels peaceful and fulfilled after lovemaking, needing little more than the air and the other person.
A persuasive note urging a woman who is leaving not to lose the singer's number and to call later.
A playful duet of mock devotion, with teasing promises of gifts and reassurance of love.
A singer falls for a free-spirited charmer fast and fears losing the freedom she values.
A jilted lover says they cannot go on after an ex keeps refusing their calls and will not see them.

songs.t: Never, Never Gonna Give You Up
songs.s: A devoted singer promises never to give up on a partner and to give everything for their love.
A demanding lover insists a partner show affection and boasts they can satisfy them better than anyone.

songs.t: You and Me Against the World
songs.s: A parent and child face the world together, and the child promises to stay.
Dead rock and soul stars form a heavenly band, and the singer imagines them playing together.
A musician arrives in Hollywood chasing his dream and hails the city's swinging nightlife.

songs.t: Be Thankful for What You Got
songs.s: Dignity and gratitude matter more than flashy cars, so stay proud with whatever you have.
A lover urges a partner to hang on and promises passion, building toward a sensual moment together.
A singer praises a beloved as a promise, a sunny morning and a fountain that feeds every hope.
A worker grinds through the commute and the job, then boasts about running his own business.
A long-haul driver races through the night toward a lover who calls for him across the miles.
A drifter turns down his lover's pleas to settle in one city after another, longing for home.
Troubles and heartbreak pile up, so keep smiling through the rain and flow with the changes.
A man searches everywhere for a companion to share daily life, cook his breakfast and hold him.
A call to pray for the struggling and sing together in harmony so the whole world can hear.
A happy couple keeps moving, grooving and kissing, with a love that feels real and lasting.
A wistful farewell to a young person whose dreams will fade as they grow up and leave.
A woman mocked by everyone in town begs to be left alone, hiding a hurt she cannot bear.
A star quits the flashy road and society's expectations to return to a simple, honest life.
After a long search, the singer finds new meaning in life and asks heaven who they really are.
A doctor's advice to dance is the cure, so boogie and slide to keep yourself alive.
Money corrupts people into betraying family and selling themselves, so do not let it change you.
A man on the run from a sheriff's killing insists he shot the lawman in self-defense and was never a deputy killer.
A playful, nostalgic tribute to a bold young woman named Jet who loved to fly and tease.

songs.t: Don't Let the Sun Go Down on Me
songs.s: A heartbroken man begs a lover not to let the sun set on their love and let his hurt heal.
A singer offers a love song and the peaceful feeling of home, promising to rock a lover all night.

songs.t: I'm Leaving It (All) Up to You
songs.s: A hurt lover hands the choice to his partner, asking whether they still want his love or are through.
A singer calls a lover, admitting fear of commitment and a wish to stay free without changing the other.
A list of simple everyday pleasures, from pickup trucks and rain to friends, ends in love for you.

songs.a: The Guess Who featuring Wolfman Jack
songs.s: A hype tribute to a radio DJ who rates records, mixed with a playful account of a flirtatious drive.

songs.t: I'll Have to Say I Love You in a Song
songs.s: A late-night caller struggles to say I love you directly, so he admits it in a song instead.
A chaotic, mock-religious spoken prayer that riffs on heaven, revenge, and who will get to enter it.

songs.t: Trying to Hold on to My Woman
songs.s: A man swears off the streets and vows loyalty to his woman, who stood by him through hard times.
A reassuring singer tells a woman not to worry, promising to stand by her while she finds her way.
A singer promises a special love song, to be played softly on the radio for the whole lonely world.
Two men love the same woman, and one confronts the other over her, bitterly claiming her as his.
A driver races a beloved bus named Helen down the motorway, past towns from Glasgow to London.
A lover regrets giving everything to a partner who was cold, unfaithful, and never gave back.
A comic farm tale about a plant that brothers smoked for a buzz until a government man wiped it out.
A man recalls a carefree Los Angeles summer of surfing and high school dances with a girl he lost.
A older brother pleads with his younger brother to come back from the street life they once shared.
A proud father celebrates his toddler son who sings the blues, recalling his birth on the road.
A singer admits a sincere love despite having someone else waiting, accepting that the moment must end.
After a breakup, the singer promises a lover that they can always count on them for love and support.
A singer says a wild lover makes everything groovy and begs them to hold on tight and shake it.
A song about a powerful love that can lift a weak man up and turn the world around, though lonely waits follow.
A singer insists love will keep a partner together and warns other girls off, staying strong and faithful.
A struggling performer dreams of stardom on Broadway, chasing the bright lights while hustling through the rain.
A reflective singer praises the freedom of Philadelphia after leaving behind family ties and the old life.
A man tells his ex that he will be there for her before the next tear falls, if she ever needs him.
A man recalls a childhood sweetheart he adored in secret, from schoolyard days to a distant, unrequited love.
A man says he needs no money or fancy car, since his sweet woman treats him right and sets his soul on fire.
A pep talk urging everyone to shine and trust themselves, from a narrator who stands on his own.
A sardonic warning that fame corrupts and empties people, delivered with a chanted refrain about what fame is good for.
A couple walks in the rain, shelters under a tree and shares a kiss, delighting in the moment.
A restless singer vows to find a mysterious woman one night, chasing an elusive dream through the lonely dark.

songs.t: Thank God I'm a Country Boy
songs.s: A contented farmer thanks his luck for his wife, his fiddle, his kids and the simple country life.
A jilted narrator accuses a lover of lying and misleading talk, feeling taken for a fool.
A regretful singer offers a lover his best love even though their relationship is slipping away.
An ecstatic love song praising a partner whose presence makes every day beautiful and feel like a dream.
A party anthem urging listeners to dance and raise their hands, with a disco kung fu fighter as its hero.
A carefree traveler floats down the Mississippi on a raft, dreaming of Dixieland music and honky tonk fun.
A chaotic party erupts into a frantic ballroom dance-off, with a warning that the crowd is about to go wild.

songs.t: (Hey Won't You Play) Another Somebody Done Somebody Wrong Song
songs.s: A lonely listener asks a band to play a sad song about lost love so he can feel less alone.

songs.t: He Don't Love You (Like I Love You)
songs.s: A jilted lover tells a woman her new partner only plays with her heart and could never love her as he does.
A woman looks back on her unpopular teenage years, learning that love and status went only to the pretty and rich.

songs.a: Van McCoy & the Soul City Symphony

songs.s: A bold character from New Orleans propositions men in a sultry, suggestive story set to a funky chorus.
A repeated plea for unity across race and class, poking fun at unfair welfare lines and secret agencies.
A seductive plea for a partner to give in tonight, because love cannot wait any longer.
A playful invitation for a partner to keep dancing, with teasing talk about making love under the stars.
A jilted singer dedicates a sad song to a bandmate and laments a lover who never truly loved him back.
A lonely young woman retreats into radio fantasies while a menacing neighbor and a missing boy haunt her town.
A call to resist the powerful and their red tape, from a frustrated narrator who has been silenced and shoved aside.
A narrator sympathizes with a woman who hides inside her room, chasing wishes that never come true.
A sizzling funk track where the narrator is set ablaze by a flirtatious partner's walk, talk and moves.
A dreamy morning song about lazing in bed, loving sunny days and believing in a little bit of magic.
A waiting partner begs the postman to check for a letter from a faraway boyfriend who has not written.
A correspondent who has been out of touch admits missing a golden-haired partner and asks for a little love.

songs.t: Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds
songs.s: A surreal dreamscape of drifting toward a mysterious girl, closing with a live-show introduction and banter.
A regretful narrator who pushed a lover away now aches for her, admitting she made him feel happy and alive.
A gentle voice urges a busy listener to slow down, rest and find peace from within.
A smitten lover pleads for a partner to come close, hoping their romance is the magic they have been waiting for.
A father realizes too late that work made him miss his son's life, and that the boy grew up just like him.
A haunting legend of a rider who died in a winter storm and returns on her horse named Wildfire to ride off with the narrator.
A new woman comforts a man still mourning his ex, insisting she is someone new and not the woman he lost.

songs.t: Listen to What the Man Said
songs.s: A breezy reassurance that love is kind and will grow, with a spoken shout-out to New Orleans and a call to listen.
A coy narrator insists they are not in love, yet keeps calling and asks the other not to tell friends about them.
A suitor offers to lend a hand to a lonely woman, even to step in as a father figure for her child.
An eager narrator confesses long-held feelings for a partner and says he feels like falling in love right now.
A heartbroken narrator wishes he had never met a girl who is gone, still aching to hold her again.
A woman who keeps being cheated and mistreated asks, over and over, when she will finally be loved.
A narrator gives a passing girl a ride in his van, and they spend a night together before she moves on.

songs.t: You're the First, the Last, My Everything
songs.s: A devoted lover calls a partner their everything and promises eternal love, singing partly in Italian.
A woman in a bar asks the jukebox operator not to play the song her ex loved, which still hurts.
A narrator who has moved on tells a former partner, over and over, that he is no good and she is leaving.
A tired traveler keeps walking, singing and longing to reach home and the lover he has missed.

songs.t: The Way We Were/Try to Remember
songs.s: A reflective song longing for the good old days and asking whether the past was really better than it seems.
A couple on the rocks decides to try once more, hoping their old love can survive the rough patch.

songs.t: Don't Call Us, We'll Call You
songs.s: A band hears a record label executive brush them off after a phone call, in a dry, wry account of industry rejection.
A giddy admirer begs a charming man who makes words rhyme to stay and keep talking, delighting in his flirtatious charm.
Suspicious that a partner is cheating with friends, the narrator doubts the denials and asks how long it has gone on.
A chanted train hook where the express keeps chugging along, built to get a crowd moving.

songs.t: That's the Way of the World
songs.s: A celebratory party anthem urging listeners to stay young at heart and find joy despite hard times.
A sweet love ballad praising a lady whose love lifts the narrator up and soothes his loneliness.
Deeply in love with someone he cannot live without, the narrator feels it is a bad time to be in love.
A bitter critique of domestic abuse, showing a woman's suffering and the neglect that leaves her alone.
A woman pines for her absent man, joking that only his return can cure her as the doctor prescribed.
An invitation to dance and get together with a lover tonight, repeated as a hook to get down.
A two-timing man admits his cheating, apologizes, and says his partner keeps forgiving him.
A simple devotional love song calling a partner beautiful, a guiding light and heaven's gift.
A repeated hook of longing and desire for a partner who fills the narrator's thoughts and body.

songs.t: How Sweet It Is (To Be Loved by You)
songs.s: A grateful thank-you to a partner who brightens every day and shelters the narrator with love.
An invitation to dance, promising the night and love will lift the partner off the ground.
A playful hook where the singer begs for a share of a lover, using cake as a sly metaphor for sex.
Trapped in a troubled relationship, the narrator keeps returning, insisting she can never say goodbye to her man.

songs.t: I Don't Like to Sleep Alone
songs.s: A plea for a partner to stay the night, admitting loneliness and wanting to know them better.
Two lovers live on opposite sides of a mountain and hill, separated yet only a kiss away from love.

songs.t: When Will I See You Again
songs.s: A plea asking when the narrator will see a beloved again, wondering if they are in love or just friends.

songs.t: Get Down, Get Down (Get on the Floor)
songs.s: A call to the dance floor for a kung fu bump, urging everyone to get down and let the good time roll.
A lonely narrator apologizes to an absent partner, regretting lies and taking things for granted, yet mostly sorry for himself.
A glamorous, cool woman who dazzles with luxury and charm, admired from a distance by the narrator.
Encouragement to a shoeshine boy to keep working hard, rise up and never forget where he came from.
A repeated hook urging listeners to keep going at whatever pleases them until they are fully satisfied.

songs.t: Can't Get It Out of My Head
songs.s: Obsessed with a mysterious woman glimpsed at the shore, the narrator cannot stop thinking of her.
A plea for a partner to make the narrator happy, having been away and missing their love.
A message to lonely and single people not to give up, since love and life can still come around.
A love song thanking a partner for the strength to keep going, asking to be loved right.
A hook insisting love can happen in a minute, even while jobs and time are scarce, so let's fall in love.
A comic refusal of drugs and liquor offered by visitors, repeated with each new offer.
A playful, rambling trip to Junior's Farm, full of silly anecdotes about poker, grocery prices and bad luck.
A witty jungle allegory where the narrator is a tiger in love but a snake in arguments.
A hungry hobo wanders into a feast, must dance for his dinner, and proudly shows off his dance moves.
Dazzled and helpless, the narrator walks on air, misty and too much in love with a partner.
Recalling a near-breakdown after escaping a controlling partner, the narrator credits someone with saving his life.
The narrator warns a friend that a deceitful woman has fooled him, and bad blood brings trouble.
Grateful for a lover who lifted the narrator out of loneliness, promising a brighter future together.
A taunt to a partner who has lovers and friends but no real love, while the narrator burns with desire.
A devoted love song saying only the beloved can brighten the world and make the narrator's dream come true.
A cynical one-night motel fling between two strangers from a bar, told with wry detachment about cheap romance.
A tongue-in-cheek story about a devil woman's romance, with the narrator promising the best is yet to come.
A devoted singer swears to God he will love one partner forever and dedicates his life to them.
A DJ hypes the crowd to get on the dance floor and let the disco music rock the boat.
The narrator defends silly love songs, insisting love is not silly and that his feelings are real.
A duet asking a partner not to break the singer's heart, having given them the key to his door.
A dancer praises a woman who moves beautifully on the disco floor, urging everyone to shake it up and move around.
A nostalgic memory of a mesmerizing woman met one late December night in 1963 that changed the narrator forever.
A former rock singer learns a lesson from a disco crowd and vows to keep playing funky music until he dies.
A farewell where the narrator must end a secret romance, asking the partner to kiss and say goodbye.
A playful robotic love song where the narrator works only for one partner and asks to be switched on.
A witty advice song in which a woman lists fifty playful ways to leave a relationship and get yourself free.
A singer feels love come alive inside him, a joyful, burning declaration of passion for a partner.

songs.a: Walter Murphy & The Big Apple Band

songs.s: A lover begs Sara to smile, promising comfort and a bond that will last forever.
A man invites his lover to an afternoon of lovemaking, teasing playfully about how they will spend the day.
A narrator claims to be music itself, boasting that every song the world sings starts with them.
A repeated chant urges a robin to fly up into the sky.
A lover refuses any cure for the sweet, consuming hangover of being in love and turns away help.
A lover asks to be drawn closer but resents being taken for granted and wants exclusive, faithful love.
A lover playfully demands more and asks how they like it, as if cameras are rolling on a sexual tease.
A man confesses to a killing, pleads for mercy in an operatic cry, and faces a fate he cannot escape.
A person who can't forget a lost love finds that every thought of them turns their whole world misty blue.
A couple dances all night with boogie fever, a playful craze that seems to be spreading everywhere.

songs.t: I'd Really Love to See You Tonight
songs.s: A man calls an old flame wanting to see her tonight, insisting he is not asking for commitment or change.
A man marvels at a sexy lover who appeared like a miracle, fulfilling a longing he had given up on.
Love is painful and deceptive, a lie that wounds anyone who is not tough enough to take it.
Dream, sing and dance without stopping, letting go of the past because time keeps moving and never returns.
A restless dreamer asks a lover whether they would still be theirs if everything fell apart.
An upbeat call for everybody to hit the dance floor, shake their booty and stop fighting the feeling.
A singer hopes sweet, universal love and understanding will guide lonely people through hard times to a brighter day.

songs.t: Right Back Where We Started From
songs.s: A lover pleads to return to where the relationship began, insisting that love can be strong again.
A lover is urged to dance, with a sensual, playful invitation from a partner who gives energy and warmth.

songs.t: You'll Never Find Another Love Like Mine
songs.s: A jilted lover insists no one will ever love the other person as they do, warning they will miss it.
Someone urges a hopeless lover not to give up, promising a shared, bright future and steady devotion.
On a moonlit coastal drive, a narrator hopes the night and its moon will lead a new romance somewhere special.
A narrator recalls a first love at sixteen, admitting they were both too young to understand what it meant.
Love is a natural season to open up and share with everything around, letting it flow, grow and shine.
A dreamer boards a dream train to escape today's troubles and float toward the moon and starry skies.
A celebration of percussion and rhythm, urging listeners to turn the beat around and move to it.
A lonely lover mourns a lost partner, begs to be taken back and promises to change their ways.
Someone who once loved independence now feels lonely, dreading being alone and missing old friends.
A sensual lover repeats a longing to make love, with breathy moans and an erotic, hypnotic chant.
A dreamer longs for a lost lover who returns in memories, promising to meet again in dreams.

songs.t: Theme from Mahogany (Do You Know Where You're Going To)
songs.s: A reflective song asks a lover where they are headed and whether they know what they hope for.
A lover pleads with someone who keeps them at arm's length, begging for love before they lose their mind.
A cheerful, repetitive chant about the way a lover treats the singer, from tender touch to passionate love.
A lover asks for a little more time together, offering to stay up until dawn and keep loving.
A child grieves a lost family member, hoping they drift to a faraway island while their mother struggles to cope.
A lover pleads for the other not to leave, saying a rare love like theirs is too precious to throw away.
A singer warns a young man that chasing the crowd and buying a lover's affection leads to a dirty, sad truth.
A lost narrator pleads for guidance and love, asking someone to show them the way every day.
A singer reflects on the years passing and life's lessons, urging listeners to sing and keep on dreaming.
A joyful singer loves any groovy music, which makes dancing, romance and life sweeter.
A woman falls for a lover who keeps her hooked and wants to hear them say they love her.
A reflective call to gather moments and treasure dreams, since the joy and sorrow of life are worth remembering.
A man warns against a sultry fortune teller whose potion and spell will trap him, as she wants to get him.

songs.t: Fooled Around and Fell in Love
songs.s: A former playboy admits a string of flings ended when he fell in love, and now he cannot let go.
Truckers form a CB-radio convoy, dodging bears, police roadblocks and tolls as they roll across the country.
Old friends welcome back a former drifter, teasing him about the dreams that took him away and brought him home.
A chorus urges anyone feeling down to sing, believing a song can lift the day and make a way forward.

songs.t: Heaven Must Be Missing an Angel
songs.s: A lover praises a heavenly partner so loving that heaven seems to have lost an angel to them.
A man promises to treat his partner well and asks for one more chance to win her back.
A celebration of rock and roll music as the perfect music for dancing and having fun.
A mother advises her daughter to take her time and shop around before committing to a man.
Excited teens look forward to a Saturday night of dancing, partying and a date.
A narrator describes a Jamaican woman working in New York and questions the divide between her world and his.
A relaxed invitation to make love again, celebrating sweet summer mornings and everyday togetherness.
Someone answers the door to welcome a list of friends and family inside for a party.

songs.a: Wing and a Prayer Fife and Drum Corps
songs.s: A playful old-fashioned love song about falling hard for a sweetheart with a cute face.
Two people in a lonely relationship pretend all is fine while drifting apart and hiding their pain.
A jilted narrator accuses a manipulative former lover of using him and wishes her ruin.
Lovers agree to part ways after the passion fades, keeping only happy memories of their time together.
A man admits he is easily hurt by a lover who toys with him, yet he will go along with it.
A call to wake up, vote and unite for change, raising children to be strong and to care for others.
Cheerful portrait of summer fun: cruising, music, beaches, street games and warm nights everywhere.
A man decides to open his heart and let a new woman into his life after years of holding back.
A mocking taunt aimed at a pretentious person who name-drops and wants to run away from criticism.
A mysterious, free-spirited woman named Rhiannon is described and admired as someone unattainable.

songs.t: Got to Get You into My Life
songs.s: A devoted lover says he needs to bring his partner into his life somehow, and he wants to stay with her.
A man pleads with his lover to be tender with his love, since it is all he has.
A fed-up narrator feels misunderstood and unwanted, and wants to fly away from people who hurt him.
A heartbroken man mourns a lost lover, drinking to cope and wishing he could move on.
A couple still in love after many years, enjoying their bond, humor and passion as they grow older.
A grateful partner celebrates a long-time love who is also a true best friend and sunshine in life.
A lover marvels at how he feels since meeting his partner and asks what she is doing to him.
An invitation to a slow, sensual ride and all-night rock and roll dancing with a fine woman.
A chant-along party song built on a repeated call for everybody to do what they want.

songs.t: The Boys Are Back in Town
songs.s: Returning boys arrive in town, stir up the nightlife and promise a rowdy weekend of trouble at the bar.
A man decides to leave a relationship before love hurts him, even as his partner clings tighter.
A love song praising a partner's way of loving, set against sunsets, moonlight and fireflies.
Encouragement for women to leave bad relationships, love themselves and find freedom in their own lives.
A bitter narrator says a partner only cares about money and expects luxury and breakfast in bed.

songs.t: Give Up the Funk (Tear the Roof off the Sucker)
songs.s: A funk party call to dance, tear the roof off and keep the groove going all night long.
A health-food devotee secretly eats junk food at night, comically hiding his cravings from his friends.

songs.t: Tryin' to Get the Feeling Again
songs.s: A man frantically searches for the lost spark he once felt for his woman before she comes home.
A live party anthem about rocking and partying every day, with crowd call-and-response and sing-along chants.

songs.a: Rick Dees & His Cast of Idiots
songs.s: A comic disco story about a duck who cannot stop dancing once the party gets going, told in silly voices.
An outlaw couple flees after a robbery turns violent, escaping with the money and running south.
A comic tale of a mama whose endless accordion playing keeps the whole house and street awake and miserable.

songs.t: Country Boy (You Got Your Feet in L.A.)
songs.s: A man who made it in Los Angeles longs for his Tennessee roots and the days he sang his songs for free.
A man seduces a nervous lover, promising a night of passion and urging her to let go of her inhibitions.

songs.t: I Just Want to Be Your Everything
songs.s: A man begs his lover to let him be her everything, pledging devotion and a life full of love.
A joyful declaration of love, celebrating a partner who makes life better and lets love grow every day.

songs.t: Evergreen (Love Theme from A Star Is Born )
songs.s: A singer describes an everlasting love that stays fresh and ageless, shared by two people.
A man learns his partner has been cheating and predicts she will be unfaithful with someone else tonight.
Daydreams of a romance on a sunny beach with a lover, a future family and a happy home together.
A woman begs her lover not to leave, pleading that she cannot survive without his love and touch.

songs.t: (Your Love Has Lifted Me) Higher and Higher
songs.s: A woman feels uplifted by a new love that helped her move past disappointment and heartbreak.
A playful fantasy about a sexy angel who visits the narrator, with jokes about fame and pop culture.
A woman confesses she loves two partners at once and asks the one she loved first to stay despite the guilt.
A flirtatious man offers to be a lover's boogie man, eager to please her at any time of day.
A teen celebrating the night at a disco, feeling carefree and dancing to the beat.

songs.t: You Make Me Feel Like Dancing
songs.s: Smitten singer says a lover makes them want to dance all night long.
A laid-back island-loving singer jokes about wasting away at a beach bar with drinks and blame.
Lonely singer waits by a silent telephone, hoping an old love will pick up.
Singer warns a man that losing his girlfriend will leave him lost and mocked by friends.
Singer asks a lover whether they want real commitment or just a casual fling, and warns against lying.
Stevie Wonder celebrates music's power to move people and honors jazz pioneers like Ellington.
A traveler gets trapped at a strange luxury hotel where the excess and hospitality cannot be escaped.
Singer urges a crowd to dance at a funky party and let loose on the floor.
A boxer training hard through pain and sweat, determined to rise and win the fight.
Singer praises warm southern nights, skies and trees, wishing the world could stop fighting.
Singer scorns a wealthy woman who relies on an older man's money and thinks cash solves everything.
Singer longs for a faraway partner, feeling close by closing their eyes and imagining them near.
Singer keeps calling a lover, burning with desire and wanting nothing but a private connection.
A car wash crew pumps up the crowd, joking about hard summer work and the boss letting them rest.

songs.t: You Don't Have to Be a Star (To Be in My Show)
songs.s: Singer tells a partner they need no fame to be loved, promising unconditional acceptance and devotion.
Singer longs to soar free like an eagle, rising through a revolution that feeds and shelters everyone.
Singer begs a lover not to give up, pleading that they still have a chance to reconcile.
A narrator keeps going through a broken romance, putting on a smile while sad inside.
Singer finds new love after a long wait, feeling as if every moment with them is the first.
Singer roams from city to city searching for direction, feeling lost and unable to find a way out.
Singer leaves a relationship and declares a carefree, laid-back life, wanting only to be free.
Singer suggests a romantic night under the stars, when the moment feels right for making love.

songs.t: I've Got Love on My Mind
songs.s: Singer is overflowing with love for a partner who makes them feel complete and happy every day.
A dazzled narrator races through a surreal, chaotic night, blinded by light and carried by a wild crowd.
Singer meets a former lover and wonders whether either truly moved on after their past love.
Singer is hopelessly smitten after a stranger catches their eye, eagerly hoping the attraction is mutual.
A singer watches a lover drift toward freedom, feeling lonely and haunted by what was lost.
Singer urges a shy partner to loosen up, dance and have fun while the music plays.
Chanting band urges everyone to dance to disco jazz, shake their bodies, and let the music move them.
Singer thanks a partner for giving the love they never had, saying their bond is priceless.
A bar patron watches a husband beg his wife Lucille, who left him with four children, not to go.

songs.t: The Things We Do for Love
songs.s: Singer reflects that love brings heartbreak and compromise, and that couples keep making up after breaking up.
Shy singer recounts meeting a girl named Jill on a Monday and walking her home, hoping to win her.
A self-assured singer brags that he can fix any broken heart and is always on call for love.

songs.t: Just a Song Before I Go
songs.s: A touring musician recalls saying goodbye at the airport to a lover, then flying away to be alone.
A working man finds contentment with his partner, sharing a bed, love and TV, calling it enough.
Singer slow dances with a girl at night, swaying to the radio as the lights dim.
A boy grows up feeling unloved after a sister arrives, leaves home seeking love, and repeats the cycle.
Singer longs for carefree childhood days of mischief, Christmas toys and candy, wishing they would return.
Singer encourages a downcast listener to look ahead, leave yesterday behind, and believe tomorrow will be better.
Singer confronts an ex-lover who keeps trying to ambush and trap them with manipulative charm.
Singer dreams in vivid colors about a lover's letter, imagining flying across the sea to their arms.

songs.a: Bob Seger & The Silver Bullet Band
songs.s: Singer recalls teenage summer flings in a car, reminiscing about restless nights of carefree, unserious romance.
Singer declares a partner is their whole world, and that losing their love would be the end.

songs.t: Heard It in a Love Song
songs.s: A restless man leaves his lover at dawn, admitting he always wants what lies over the hill.
Singer encourages a troubled wanderer to rest, find peace and let go, hoping heaven waits for them.
Narrator watches a newcomer steal the affection of a lover, feeling replaced by the new kid in town.
Singer admits love has faded and asks a former partner if their old love still mattered.
Singer sings a lullaby to a lover after lovemaking, admitting the song is simple but still feels deeply loving.
A traveler leaves home by plane, longing for home while knowing he has to keep moving on.
A lovelorn singer urges himself and his lover to stay calm and not throw their relationship away.
A lover's touch overwhelms the singer, who feels swept away by desire and music.
A singer aches for a lover after a short trip, counting the days until they can meet again.

songs.t: It Was Almost Like a Song
songs.s: A singer mourns a breakup, recalling a perfect year that ended suddenly and left him heartbroken.
A bitter narrator confronts a cheating partner who is slipping away, and tells her to leave.
A jilted lover accuses a cold partner of throwing away a relationship and will pay for it.
A memorable night after a New Jersey suburban date, with a girl named Ariel, told with comic detail.
A man who is lost without his lover begs her to return, wishing things could go back as before.
Four men each introduce a zodiac-named persona and invite women to a party of love and floating.
A rider pulls on his jeans and heads out on his motorbike to meet his lover for the weekend.
A drifter named Lido keeps taking one more risky job before he runs for the road.
A repeated plea to keep affection flowing and not let the feelings stop or dry up.

songs.t: You Made Me Believe in Magic
songs.s: After despair, a new love restores the singer's sense of purpose and makes life feel magical again.
A love that feels like a living thing, and the fear of losing it while drifting apart.
A plea to share love, time and kindness with others, especially people who feel lonely.
A sixteen-year-old discovers rock and roll, and the thrill of getting the crowd to dance.
After a night of intimacy, a love that felt right turns out to be wrong and the lover is gone.
A crowd is urged to dance to a performer who plays a rubber band with his toes and nose.
A singer claims to be emotionally tough, hiding heartache and drinking, insisting he never cries.
A devoted love song praising a partner who makes the singer feel safe and admired above all others.
Nostalgic invitation to a high school dance, where the music, romance and rhythm are the point.
A gentle devotion that grows from friendship into a deep, lifelong love shared side by side.

songs.t: Ain't Gonna Bump No More (With No Big Fat Woman)
songs.s: A man complains that a heavier dancer knocked him to the floor and he will no longer dance.

songs.t: I Wanna Get Next to You
songs.s: A man with little money pleads with a woman he adores to let him win her attention.
A man overworked and unloved cries out in prayer, desperate for someone to love him.
Two muskrats fall in love, dance at a town celebration and marry in a silly whimsical courtship.
A comic recollection of teenage romance and sexual conquests at school, with party banter for a birthday.
A cynical tale of a man who loses his lady and falls into cheating and misery in the city.
A traveler is swept into a passionate stay with a mysterious woman in North Africa and remains for a year.
An invitation to dance all night at a party, because boogie nights are the best in town.
A breakup song telling a former lover to go their own way and accept that the relationship is over.

songs.t: Sorry Seems to Be the Hardest Word
songs.s: A plea for forgiveness from a partner who will not talk, asking what it takes to be loved.
A reassurance to a lover that everything will turn out alright, delivered with tenderness and calm.
A couple's breakup at a family home, accepting that they are through and that nothing can be done.
A man asks how much love to offer before confessing feelings, afraid of pushing too hard.
A warning that people face a dangerous threat with nowhere to run and must take a stand now.
A devoted lover dances through the night, offering affection and surrendering to one partner's guidance.
A night of disco fever when everyone moves to the music and the singer feels alive and connected.
A lonely person's life is brightened by a new love that brings hope and fills the nights.
A defiant assertion of survival in a tough city, with a dancer who refuses to give up on life.
A passionate singer longs to kiss a lover all over and promises to stay devoted through the night.
A devoted singer promises deep, loyal love and vows that both lovers belong together.
A man regrets letting his partner go and begs her to come back, admitting he cannot live without her.
An obsessive singer cannot leave a lover who hurts him and accepts the pain as part of devotion.
An upbeat call to get on the floor and dance until no one can dance anymore.
A grateful, tender love song praising a partner for shared years and promising to devote every moment.
An upbeat anthem celebrating teenage love and the freedom to be yourself, with a crowd chant.
A singer still longs for a former lover who now has someone new, and feels crazy when seeing her.

songs.t: You're the One That I Want
songs.s: Playful duet where two lovers declare they want only each other and agree to be a couple.
Abandoned singer aches for a lover who left her and cries alone, pleading for their return.
Smooth singer begs a woman to stay and rest in his arms under the velvet sky.
Restless man waits by the phone for a lover who keeps him sleepless, then vows he will not miss her.
Singer tells his partner not to change for him and promises to love her exactly as she is.
Hopeful call for a couple to join forces, using a little luck and love to fix their troubles together.
Heartbroken singer says she would rather go crazy than live on without the lover who left her.
Pure dance-floor celebration urging everyone to keep moving, with chanted refrains and a sweet, hazy partner.
A young woman roams the city drawing stares, and the singer invites her back to his place.
Love is vital and dangerous like oxygen, and the singer aches with city blues after losing a lover.
Singer warns that loving a man who does not care for you leads to heartache and humiliation.

songs.t: We Will Rock You / We Are the Champions
songs.s: Stomping crowd anthem urging a tough young boy to stand up and take on the world.
Watching a disillusioned man on Baker Street, the singer sees dreams of settling down slip away, then heads home.
Singer says he cannot smile, laugh or sing without his partner, feeling sad when she is sad.

songs.t: Too Much, Too Little, Too Late
songs.s: Former lovers admit it is over, too late to try again, and agree to end it as friends.
Repetitive disco invitation to dance with the singer, promising joy and freedom for anyone feeling blue.

songs.t: Two Out of Three Ain't Bad
songs.s: Singer tells a rejected lover that two out of three ain't bad, admitting he cannot give her the love she wants.
Nursery-rhyme Jack sneaks down the hill because Jill leaves him alone and he craves love.
Singer tells a hesitant lover she is still free and asks for a chance to prove her love.
Honest singer admits intimacy overwhelms him, wanting to hold his lover until his fear fades.
Disco singer begs for one last dance and a shot at romance, asking her partner to be her Mr. Right.
Singer admits she is still hopelessly devoted to a lover who pushed her love aside, unable to stop.
