songs.t: De Do Do Do, De Da Da Da
songs.s: A wordplay-heavy song mocking how poets, priests and politicians use words to control people.
A man warns anyone who wants his girl that she is his alone and he will not back down.
A woman asks her partner to stop dragging her heart around and to let her be her own person.

songs.t: Giving It Up for Your Love
songs.s: A man gives everything for his lover's love, turning down money and cars because he has everything he needs.
A narrator tells a lover that feeling a little in love is normal, and that they feel it too.
Immigrants travel far from home toward America, seeking freedom and a new life under its flag.

songs.t: Ain't Even Done with the Night
songs.s: A young man and his girlfriend cannot bear to end their night together, even when it is time to go home.

songs.t: Arthur's Theme (Best That You Can Do)
songs.s: A man falls for a woman lost in late-night Manhattan, and decides that falling in love is the best he can manage.
A violent street-style rap verse full of bragging and threats, laid over a chanted chorus.
A narrator feels lost and sad in a world of games and lies, unsure whether to trust anyone's word.
A partner keeps cheating and the narrator refuses to put up with it any longer.
Advice to grab every chance and fake it, since nobody else will rescue you now.
A celebration of peace and music, promising a party that keeps going until dawn.
A friend calls late to say hello and admits they miss the other person a lot.

songs.t: Don't Stand So Close to Me
songs.s: A teacher is drawn to a much younger student while the school gossip spreads quickly.
An older man reminisces about his youth and struggles to connect with a much younger woman.

songs.t: I Ain't Gonna Stand for It
songs.s: A man refuses to stand for a partner's cheating and vows to stop accepting the betrayal.
A tribute to a late friend, recalling his message of love and his lasting influence on the world.
Simple steps for a shy man to win a woman's love: ask her out, flatter her, commit.
A boastful, sleazy song about lust, competition and party excess with drug references.
A giddy love song about being held close and kissed, feeling everything is right.
A man longs to win back a lost love and promises he will always be by her side.
Years after a past romance, two old lovers meet by chance and share drinks and regrets.
A chance meeting grows into an easy, relaxed love that feels like rain on a summer day.
Encouragement to hold tight to your dreams through heartbreak, loneliness and hard times.
A plea to seize the moment and kiss a lover tonight before it is too late.
A woman demands to be treated well and warns a lover she is done being taken for granted.
A man rises from failure, reclaims his life and declares he will keep winning from now on.
A jilted narrator blames a cheating partner for leaving them in pain and uncertainty.
A man steps back from the rat race and chooses to watch life slowly pass him by.
A demand that a lover stop playing games and be honest about what they really feel.
A man hitchhikes home through the rain searching for a lost love in the mountains.

songs.t: I Made It Through the Rain
songs.s: A devoted lover promises to be always there and claims no one else compares to her.
A man begs a lover to restore the spark they lost, pleading not to let the love slip away.
Overwhelmed by a new love, the narrator feels everything suddenly falls into place.
A private, intimate love the narrator shares only with one person, letting them see the real self.
A medley celebrating surf, cars and carefree summers along the California coast.
An upbeat call to fix any problem quickly, before it gets worse and nothing can be undone.
An independent modern woman juggles work and city life, content to build her world on her own terms.
A lonely man admits he badly wants to truly know someone and show them how he feels.
A woman urges a lover who is coasting on past glory to stop running and face reality.
A declaration of finally revealing your true self and letting the whole world see it.
A lover misses their partner through the night and hopes the morning brings them back together.
Love and time are described as the forces that keep the singer going and make things right.
A woman pushes for a physical, sexual relationship after a dinner date, ready to stop waiting.
A fighter rises after a fall and refuses to give up, determined to survive the rival's challenge.
A young woman meets a boy at a jukebox dance and they leave together, dancing the night away.
Black and white people can live together in harmony by learning to give each other what they need.
A man recalls a secret crush on his homeroom classmate, now seen in a magazine centerfold.
A woman scolds a former partner who dismisses her, reminding him what he will lose.
Two young heartland teens face growing up, dreaming of escape and the end of their carefree youth.
Painful but thrilling love that aches yet feels right, with a plea to keep it going.
A lover feels overheated and spinning with desire, begging to be kissed and taken further.
After a separation, a lover apologises and begs to be held, promising to make things right.
A woman begs a departing lover to stay, hurt by how the once-loving relationship has turned painful.
A woman who has waited too long resolves to close her heart and leave a lover behind.
A man pleads with a woman who left him, wishing he could meet her halfway and bring her back.

songs.t: I Can't Go for That (No Can Do)
songs.s: A refusal to meet every demand for more, even though he would give almost anything else.
Smitten singer keeps calling a stranger's number, hoping she'll change her mind and become his.
A lover longs to rekindle a romance, recalling old films and a shared past together.

songs.t: You Should Hear How She Talks About You
songs.s: A friend urges someone to act on a crush, reporting that the other person is lovesick and devoted.

songs.t: Waiting for a Girl Like You
songs.s: After a long wait, a man finds a true partner and vows his feelings are finally right.
A narrator warns his girlfriend not to trust a slick suitor who will only use her up.
Two experienced lovers say their bond is worth more than any past hurts or hardships.
A man regrets taking his partner for granted and begs for one more chance to make things right.
An invitation to dance all night, let loose, and shake off worries about clumsy moves.
A party-goer urges a new crowd to let loose and enjoy the night, playfully suggesting a steamy fling.
A crowd celebrates dancing to a driving beat as everyone falls into step together.
An average guy admits he is smitten with a mistress whose wild affair upended his comfortable life.
A man pleads with a partner to stop pulling away, insisting he can show her how love should work.
A lonely narrator wishes to be with a faraway beloved, longing to see her in dreams tonight.
Former lovers reflect on a failed romance, sure that only the lonely can truly play this game.
A reclusive narrator turns away visitors, fearing being taken away and feeling paranoid and alone.
A singer begs a lover to hold them close, promising that tonight everything will feel right.
A watcher claims to see and read everyone's minds, warning a deceiver that lies will not work.
An invitation to groove together tonight, letting the music lift everyone onto the dance floor.
A narrator welcomes a returning partner with open arms, asking them to stay and see what they mean.
A son honors his father, a band leader, for the music, discipline and gentle lessons he gave.
A lover asks to be held and kept close, describing a bond that makes the nights feel bearable.
A once-lonely narrator finds comfort and happiness after a partner heals their heartache.
A woman recounts travels and luxury that never brought fulfillment, urging a discontented lady to find herself.
A nostalgic narrator recalls a carefree 1965 romance tied to simple rock and roll and doo-wop.
A regretful narrator recalls impulsive youth and warns that acting on passion in the moment has a cost.
A lover begs a departing partner to be gentle and reconsider, admitting feeling lost and crying out.
A gamer spends every quarter at the arcade on Pac-Man, obsessed and eager to return the next night.
A narrator admits a woman who thinks she controls him has won his heart and that he is ready to confess.
A narrator warns a lover that they are being watched and cannot hide lies or hurt from private eyes.
A narrator admits he has forgotten love, knows he should leave, and cannot resist seeing his partner again.
Two people who survived hard times reunite, realizing love means far more than physical intimacy.

songs.t: Love's Been a Little Bit Hard on Me
songs.s: A narrator says past hurt has made them guarded, yet they still hope to open up to love again.
A young couple chases a coastal dream, faces hard times with a new baby, and urges hearts to stay free.
A photographer-minded narrator obsesses over a woman's image, freezing a moment of attraction in time.
A couple urges each other to keep their relationship alive through change, doubt and hard times.
A man meets a woman on a city street, asks whether she believes in love, and admits he is falling for her.
A man invites a former lover over for a cool night by the fire, letting go of past promises and plans.
A man admits he is completely smitten with a woman who changed his mind about love and never wants to be free.

songs.t: Why Do Fools Fall In Love?
songs.s: A narrator wonders why people fall in love, admitting that they are the fool who keeps losing.
A narrator pleads guilty to falling in love, asking to be locked away in a lover's arms forever.
An older narrator reflects on wasted time and lost love, urging others not to let their chances slip away.
A narrator is overwhelmed by new love, wondering if this feeling is real and unable to get enough.

songs.t: Love Is in Control (Finger on the Trigger)
songs.s: A narrator says love took control after a new romance, aiming straight for a lover and refusing to let go.
A narrator promises to deliver a love gift in person, since letters and calls cannot carry the feeling.
A coaching song urging a man to show love through many small gestures so his partner stays.
A narrator longs for a blue-eyed lover, remembering sun and rain and wishing to be home again.
Two friends silently ignore gossip and lies from jealous people, refusing to reveal anything to them.

songs.t: You Could Have Been with Me
songs.s: A narrator tells an unwilling partner they could have been loved instead of left alone and lonely.
A narrator tells a lover they hold magic, able to dry tears and turn a hardened heart with a word.
A narrator admits a lover swept them off their feet in a minute, wanting to be proven wrong about love.
A narrator meets a captivating girl under a glowing sky, then flees across time, unable to escape the vision.
A smitten narrator watches a beautiful girl pass by and resolves to approach her tonight.
A heartbroken narrator cannot sleep or think, consumed by love for a woman who belongs to someone else.
Asks a performer to keep playing late, while a lonely driver on a long road turns on the radio.
Still crazy for a lover who let go, the singer says it will take a miracle to love anyone new.
Love arrives unexpectedly and overturns a guarded life, pulling a man back into caring and giving again.
A small-town girl and a city boy chase their dreams on a midnight train, and a singer's night goes on.

songs.t: Comin' In and Out of Your Life
songs.s: A woman keeps drifting in and out of an ex-lover's life, unable to let go and still loving him.
A friend warns a woman she is running after men and losing herself, headed for a breakdown.
Standing at an empty garden in New York, the narrator mourns a gardener named Johnny and calls for him to come out.
Songs and trends fade away, but the simple promise of saying I love you stays the same.
A smitten singer barely knows a girl but hopes she walks over, repeating a hopeful, dreamy refrain.

songs.t: Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic
songs.s: A man is smitten but struggles to say how he feels, joking that he always ends up soaked in her rain.
Haunted by memories of a former lover, the narrator admits he cannot go on without her.

songs.t: I Keep Forgettin' (Every Time You're Near)
songs.s: Every time an ex is near, the narrator keeps forgetting they have split up and their love is over.
A party call urging listeners to leave the wall and dance, shouting that they should get down and move.
A man dreads that his restless lover will leave any day, and he will be left alone and in tears.
Impatient for romance, the singer invites a lover to stop talking and make the first move tonight.

songs.t: Take My Heart (You Can Have It If You Want It)
songs.s: Playful invitation to a lover to take the singer's heart whenever she wants, ending with a marriage proposal.
A woman feels trapped by a lover who promised answers and a fairy tale romance, and she demands to be let go.
Leaving a relationship behind without goodbye, the narrator wants a vacation alone to escape and get away.
A man spots a passing woman he admires and tries to win her attention, asking her to stay and be his tonight.
A woman wrestles with going back to a man who hurt her, tempted by desire despite her earlier vow.
On a hot summer night in New York, strangers and dreamers gather in the city for a fun, funky, romantic night.
Young people in a dirty town dance and chase new scenes, from New York to California, as the kids of America.
A singer warns a partner still tied to another man that the words of goodbye are hard to find.
The singer sees people throwing love away and asks what forever is for if love never lasts.
Standing in a doorway watching girls pass by, the narrator says he is not waiting on a lady, only a friend.
A man swears his love to a woman, promising sweet devotion, with a playful shout-out to a jazz trumpeter.
Everyone is out chasing romance and second chances, working all week just for the weekend party.
A man realizes he is falling too deep for a woman whose spell and eyes leave him unable to escape her.
A devoted partner looks back on years together, thankful the love and trust they built has only grown stronger.
Drifting memories of a young love and a night bird's call, recalled through images of doves and a dreamlike past.
A possessive narrator watches every move of a lover and insists she belongs to him, with menace and loneliness.
A man insists a woman who claims he fathered her child is lying, while warning about rumors and fame.
A dancer chases her dreams through passion and rhythm, feeling the music and dancing for her life.
A traveler on a hippie trail recounts odd encounters abroad and playfully warns that Australians should run and take cover.
Advice to a young man to walk away from a gang threat rather than fight, even though it is tempting to stand tough.
A woman falls apart from loneliness and fear without her lover, longing for him to turn around and hold her tight.
Warns a man that a wild, seductive woman who only comes out at night will chew him up and tear his world apart.
Recalling a love that was meant to be, the singer begs a partner to come close and stay, since life is empty without them.
A steel-town girl dances wildly on a Saturday night, pushing past what others call crazy to find her own fire.
Cynical take on relationships where some people use, abuse, or let themselves be abused, urging listeners to keep their heads up.

songs.t: Do You Really Want to Hurt Me
songs.s: A man pleads with a lover to stop hurting him and making him cry, saying he will leave if the pain continues.
A couple affirm their shared love and dreams, remembering their first embrace and promises that made the bond stronger.
A nostalgic invitation to a girl in a red dress, recalling a crooner from parents' generation and the joy of singing along.

songs.a: Bob Seger & The Silver Bullet Band
songs.s: A narrator reflects on how men change inside a relationship, blaming midnight and the moon for the confusion.

songs.t: She Works Hard for the Money
songs.s: A tribute to a hardworking waitress who has seen hard times, earns tips, and is respected by the people she serves.
A man who let a lover slip away promises to make things right, vowing never to let her go again.
A predatory narrator stalks a woman through the city night like a hungry wolf, hunting and closing in on her.
Invites a partner to dance in red shoes under the moonlight, promising to run and hide together for love.
A man alone in a hotel room, guilty after a shooting, realizes his fate is closing in on him.

songs.t: I Know There's Something Going On
songs.s: A partner grows distant and cold, and the singer senses the relationship is ending soon.
A singer warns a neglectful lover that their relationship is in danger and begs them to hang on.
Street hardship and poverty in the city push the singer to call for everyone to rise up together.
A man is dazzled and flustered by a brilliant, beautiful woman, mixing scientific jargon with romance.
A man travels to Africa to reconnect with a lost love, finding peace in its wide, wild landscape.
A man warns a fast-living woman in a red sports car to slow down and find lasting love.
A found photo drags the singer back into a painful past relationship and the old struggles of separation.
Love lifts two people above a troubled world to a high, clear place where they belong together.
A man hides a machine-like secret behind a mask, asking to be understood and freed from the technology around him.
A lover declares endless devotion, saying the beloved is everything and he would relive this love again.
A chorus warns listeners about a menacing police inspector and the danger of drawing his attention.
A playful invitation to dress up and show off at fashionable Park Avenue spots and the Ritz.
A man begs his lover to come over and help him, saying intimacy is the cure for his emotional turmoil.
A chant celebrating the thrill of fascination and temptation, living for passion with a young, stylish crowd.
A singer laments that time has run out on a love that could have been, with no time left to give.
A rambling party anthem urging people to dance freely, with a wish list, a defiant self-portrait and bad-day reflections.
A singer tells Mickey he looks great but keeps leaving her hanging, and begs him not to break her heart.
A lonely singer recalls advice that love cannot be rushed, finding patience hard but necessary.
Two lovers part still loving each other, and the singer promises that true love will bring them back together.
Tired of being apart, the singer wants a one-on-one night with his partner, using a game metaphor for coming home.
Two lonely people agree to spend the night together and ignore tomorrow, hoping for shelter from loneliness.
A defiant party anthem against fears of war and nuclear destruction, urging people to dance before the end.
A broke, swaggering stray cat struts past the alley scene, bragging about his cool style and ignoring mice.
Young people in a dying Pennsylvania steel town feel trapped as factories close and promised futures fade.
A jilted woman stands back from a man who never called, saying she would rather be alone than wait.
An older singer advises a young man to tell his girlfriend openly how he feels before it is too late.

songs.t: Always Something There to Remind Me
songs.s: Reminders of a lost lover are everywhere in the city, and the singer cannot forget the bond still felt.
A lover professes total devotion, saying they are truly in love and head over heels for their partner.
A TV newsman admits he profits from scandal and tells viewers to enjoy others' misfortunes and downfalls.
Two rivals playfully argue over who the girl truly belongs to, each insisting she loves him more.
A singer urges a shy girl to step closer and stop hiding, saying her shyness keeps them apart.
A singer mocks a self-righteous, sober goody-goody and claims bold independence from others' rules.
A ruler bans rock music in a North African town, yet the people and even the military start dancing to it.
A nostalgic look back at a childhood family home on a busy street, where life felt happy until the family moved on.
Sleepless nights full of worry and fear bring ghostly thoughts, and the singer wants relief from anxiety.

songs.t: Is There Something I Should Know?
songs.s: A singer pleads with a lover to reveal true feelings while feeling watched, exposed and desperate for an answer.
A passionate lover insists their intense bond runs deeper than physical attraction, an affair of the heart requiring faith.
A carnival barker sells a pretty but emotionally unavailable woman, warning listeners not to fall for the merchandise.
A jilted lover plays solitaire alone, recalling a partner who left and now wants back in, too late.
A man begs his lover not to end their relationship, promising to change and make up for his mistakes.

songs.t: How Am I Supposed to Live Without You
songs.s: A heartbroken lover learns their partner is leaving for someone else and asks how they can possibly go on.
A man is obsessed with his China girl, describing his mess without her and violent, domineering visions of control.
A singer recalls his sister's Saturday dance nights at the local ballroom and mourns its demolition as lost childhood.
A singer keeps believing a lover who makes promises and never keeps them, feeling bitter and still hopeful.
A man learns his ex is with someone new and pleads to reunite, arguing the new partner won't understand their kids.

songs.t: Making Love Out of Nothing at All
songs.s: A lover boasts of every skill he has and claims he can make love from nothing, yet cannot leave his beloved.
A married man turns down a woman seeking a one-night stand, warning he is a family man who will not be pushed.
A singer accuses a gossip of stirring trouble and making his baby cry, describing constant rumors and hurt.
A man tells his former lover he will not hold her back, admitting their lost love cannot be found again.
Encouragement to a partner that they can work through hardship and that the couple will make it.
A singer begs a former partner for a fresh start and pledges lasting devotion from the heart.
A man admits his failings to a lover and asks for one last honest chance to reconnect.
A man thanks a long-suffering partner for staying with him and tells her she blows his mind.
A defiant singer who survived a cruel partner declares they are still standing and better than before.
A flirtatious portrait of a sexually confident woman with many suitors, and the narrator who wants to be her lover.
A bitter satire of a nuclear crisis where leaders are dismissed as a mistake and ordinary people are left reeling.
A breathless, repetitive pledge to tumble for a lover and run the gun for them, with playful wordplay.
A devoted lover insists that all their love waits for a partner who has finally shown they truly care.

songs.t: Your Love Is Driving Me Crazy
songs.s: A reckless lover exults in a partner whose forbidden, intense passion takes them out of themselves.
A woman mourns a lover who keeps breaking her heart and asks why he has to be a heartbreaker.
A touring musician promises his wife he is forever hers and that she stands by him through the road.
Two tired lovers leave the TV behind and head out into the night, looking for something more alive.
A singer promises a listener a miracle if they accept her love, calling out from the radio and down the hall.
A rebellious teen skips school to meet his sexy, wild girlfriend and dance to rock and roll.
A partner asks to try again after feeling neglected, and the narrator promises more romance and closeness.
A narrator calls out a lover who secretly wants them and cannot hide it, even while pretending otherwise.
A cynical satire of consumer America, the nuclear arms race and lawyers chasing love while the world falls apart.
A poor boy and a shop girl ask the world what about them, demanding their share of a life that takes more than it gives.
A man rejects gossip about his romantic life, insisting that his wandering desires are simply human nature.
A lovesick fan has only a photograph of a glamorous, unreachable woman and longs to touch her in person.
A reggae party anthem where the narrator invites the crowd to pass the joint and dance until the night is done.
A reflective singer insists that the truth of love is the one thing they know, amid thoughts of a lost ticket to the world.
A man facing a lost chance begs a lover to save him, insisting he is down but far from over.

songs.t: I've Got a Rock 'n' Roll Heart
songs.s: A singer boasts of loving classic 1957 Chevys and screaming guitar, and promises a rock and roll heart.
A lonely man waiting by the sea hopes that the person he has waited for all his life might be his lover.
Two lovers celebrate their night together, promising to make love and leave the world behind for a shared sky of diamonds.
A bragging, flirtatious singer teases a partner about their power over them and their ambitions to win and travel.
A devoted lover tells a mistreated partner to leave the past behind and stop crying, promising to be there always.
A couple keeps fighting over what breaks them apart, finding that advice is easy to give but hard to follow.
A confident suitor promises to lift a lover up and never let them down if they fall in love with him.
A wounded lover asks why a partner walks away and why they scream at each other, comparing their fights to crying doves.

songs.t: What's Love Got to Do with It
songs.s: A woman questions whether love is just a second-hand emotion and urges a crowd to join her in asking what love does.
A jilted singer pleads with a lover who never takes him seriously, begging to be heard as he cries through the years.
A young person sick of work and rules urges everyone to kick off their shoes and dance freely.

songs.t: Against All Odds (Take a Look at Me Now)
songs.s: A man pleads with a departing lover, insisting she is the only one who knew him and that her return is against all odds.
A narrator with his back against the wall tells a listener to take the leap and jump, since they have nothing to lose.
A lover dreams of kissing someone from afar and asks whether the voice at the door is calling for them.
A motivational anthem urges listeners to move, prove themselves, and use free will rather than live as the owner of a lonely heart.
A catchy call-and-response theme asks who to call for ghosts haunting the neighborhood, declaring no fear of ghosts.
A singer accuses a fickle lover of playing games, calling them a karma chameleon whose colors would make love easy.
A man insists he is not missing a distant lover at all, while his heart breaks down a long distance line.
A party anthem invites everyone to dance, sing and jam in the street all night long, with multilingual call-and-response.

songs.t: Let's Hear It for the Boy
songs.s: A singer praises her plain, humble boyfriend, saying he may not be a Romeo but his love makes her cheer.

songs.t: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
songs.s: A young woman rejects her parents' expectations and insists that girls just want to have fun once the working day is done.
A dancer tells a lover to stop fooling around, stressing that the chance is on the line and time to decide is short.
A lover lying awake promises to catch a partner who falls and to wait for them, time after time.
A flirtatious call for a lover to jump in, promising kisses and touch, with the crowd chanting along.
A singer hears a lover's secret desires and dreams whispered in their sleep and vows to keep them close.
A woman surrenders her self-control to a lover, living for the night and dreaming of a fragile escape from daylight.
A playful call to live wildly now, mocking a shallow self-help doctor and facing mortality with joyful defiance.
A plea to a partner to deny that they are drifting away, begging for reassurance despite evident hurt.
A couple exhausted by fighting pleads to be held close, hoping love can start again despite the tears.
A man declares devotion to his girlfriend, promising to be her only man and build a good life together.

songs.t: I Just Called to Say I Love You
songs.s: A tender phone call declaring love on an ordinary day, proving simple words can carry the deepest feeling.
An ordinary man feels constantly watched and loses his privacy, unsure whether the watching is real or only paranoia.
A determined singer refuses to be slowed by a past relationship, keeps moving and rejects the hold of a rival.
Balloons mistaken for UFOs trigger a military escalation that ends in ruin, with a final hope for peace.
A lover longs for a partner who is absent tonight, finding comfort in dreaming of their embrace.
A woman craves a glamorous life of furs and cars but concludes that without love it is worth little.
A tangled romance in which both partners should have left, yet a stubborn fever keeps their love holding on.
A man comes home to his lover after being foolish, glad she waited and promising to stay with her.

songs.t: I Guess That's Why They Call It the Blues
songs.s: A lover pines for an absent partner, admitting the blues come from missing time together.
A playful anthem about female desire and self-discovery, unafraid of warnings and the danger zone.
A lover feels pushed past the limit by a partner who keeps teasing, pleading for real commitment and freedom.
A man in shades watches a deceiving lover, refusing to be controlled and warning her he sees through her game.
A bitter man reflects on a deceitful lost love and the soulless emptiness he sees in her eyes.
Rain falling like memories and new emotions stirs a yearning to walk, talk and dive into love with a partner.
A working-class man admits his love for a wealthy uptown woman, hoping she will look past class differences.
An urgent warning to a young sister growing up fast, to hold on to herself before her time comes.
A lonely voice asks who will catch a fragile lover through failures, breakdowns and dreams.
After a near-death second chance, a woman gets another shot at love, feeling her hurt gone and life worth living.
Vague tense imagery of a snake union climbing toward a breaking point, with voices on the radio.
A tribute to rock and roll across American cities, insisting its heartbeat still lives under modern flashy styles.
A man admits he is addicted to a lover who left, struggling to live without her.
A fierce call to a wild lover to embrace passion and fight through heartache, claiming victory like a warrior.

songs.t: If Ever You're in My Arms Again
songs.s: A man regrets a lost romance and promises to love better if given another chance to hold his lover forever.
A woman is overwhelmed by a lover, losing her defenses, speech and control whenever he is near.
A dancer keeps the groove going after a lost love, hoping the dance will bring the ex back to her.

songs.t: To All the Girls I've Loved Before
songs.s: A playful farewell to past loves, grateful for each woman and the lessons they taught, with a spoken rap tribute.

songs.t: Caribbean Queen (No More Love on the Run)
songs.s: A man smitten by a stylish island woman gives up his playboy ways and dreams of a lasting love.
A strained couple shrug at constant arguments, admitting feelings for each other while still feeling stuck.
A couple runs through city nights full of neon and freedom, feeling giddy and in love until morning comes.
Sad songs offer comfort when hope is gone, because shared pain on the radio helps us feel less alone.
A man wants a new drug that feels like being with his lover without the harm, sleepless nights or side effects.
A duet celebrating a devoted couple who rely on each other and sail together through love that never ends.
A couple in intense love insist they are strong and young, though their romance feels like a battlefield.
A man feels dizzy and sleepless with infatuation over a woman who makes him feel young, hoping it lasts.
A couple who finally found perfect love feel close to paradise and see forever in one another.
A band praises a stylish, independent woman with great legs and hair, celebrating her beauty and their attraction.
A man is overwhelmed by a woman who leaves him dazed and pleading for her attention and a rescue kiss.
A man warns a restless young woman chasing a quick thrill, urging her to love someone before it goes too far.
A confident lover insists the other will miss them blindly, teasing about power and promising love that can make you rich or poor.
A man confronts a partner who keeps dodging calls and begs for a clear answer on whether the relationship is over.
A wry singer admits he seems crazy for clinging to a wild, dramatic partner, yet all he wants is her.
A woman calls her lover her lucky star, promising he lights her way and makes everything right.
A weary narrator seeks a lover to shelter him from a harsh world, asking to be covered and held close.
A wild rock anthem urging the crowd to get loud and wild, shrugging off critics and feeling the noise together.
An upbeat call to dance and breakdance, celebrating a new street dance craze that makes hearts pump and fevers rise.
Teen students in high school dealing with romance, peer pressure, and the prospect of adult life.
A secret romance the narrator stays committed to despite others who disapprove and never understand.
A man pleading with a hurt lover to trust him again, insisting he is innocent of past wrongs.
Alone in a hot, crowded city after a lover has left, the narrator feels abandoned and unsettled.
Nostalgia for carefree dancing youth, when a couple and their crowd shared everything that felt true.
Insistent chant urging a lover to give in, since everybody wants them and the singer wants them all.
Eager anticipation of a night of passion, admitting excitement and giving in to desire.

songs.t: I Still Can't Get Over Loving You
songs.s: A heartbroken narrator who keeps hearing about an ex and cannot move on from loving them.
A horror-themed night when monsters close in, and the narrator promises to protect and thrill a lover.
A call for everyone to unite and take a day off to celebrate and forget troubles.
Defiant anthem of street dancers who refuse to be held back by walls, weakness or daylight.
Bewildered observations of a chaotic, absurd era where everything is happening and nothing makes sense.
Yearning for a beloved while describing love as a dangerous, mind-numbing devotion.
Tribute to a young woman who died suddenly, urging friends to laugh rather than cry.
Reassurance to a doubtful lover that love is real and will be revealed over time.
A young apprentice ensnared by a manipulative devil figure vows the tables will turn and the master will serve him.
Vignettes of ordinary American lives, celebrating and criticizing the country's promise and its disappointments.
A passionate cycle of love and heartbreak, with a defiant vow that love will find a way.
Anxious confession of running too fast, losing track of time and feeling out of control in love.
Joyful pledge to a new love, promising to hold them for a long time despite past hurts.
A memory of a sixteenth birthday night when a girl led the narrator onto the dance floor and into romance.
Euphoric declaration of love for someone who lifted the singer up after past hurts.
Flirtatious invitation to dance the night away and make a physical connection with a new partner.
Dark portrait of repression, violence and sexual exploitation under authoritarian regimes, urging secrecy.

songs.a: John Cafferty and the Beaver Brown Band
songs.s: Warning about a seductive, blinding love that draws the narrator into dark, reckless obsession.
A lonely night of longing after a lover's departure, watching the moon and feeling the cold.
An astronaut drifts away in space after losing contact with ground control, a fable of escape.
An infatuated lover says love feels magical and asks the partner to hold on tight through the night.
Longing reminiscence of a past love, wondering whether a former partner still dreams about the narrator.
Begging a lover to take the narrator away and rock them through the night.
Reassurance that God will be there for people in hardship whenever they call on him for help.
Regret over betraying a friend and losing a love, with the narrator vowing never to dance again.
Giddy celebration of a new love that makes the singer feel renewed and ready to commit forever.

songs.t: Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go
songs.s: Eager urging to be woken up in time to go dancing with a lover on a night out.

songs.t: I Want to Know What Love Is
songs.s: Searching for the meaning of love after heartache, asking a partner to show the narrator what love is.
A lover asks whether the partner feels the same physical attraction and affection, and wants to rock them.
Feeling out of step with an absent lover, lost in fantasy and waiting for them to come back.

songs.t: Everybody Wants to Rule the World
songs.s: Ironic commentary on people's hunger for power, with a call to face freedom and pleasure while it lasts.
A working man mocks video-music stars who earn easy money, grumbling about his own hard labour.
A dizzy, all-consuming infatuation with someone met on the dance floor, feeling it is brand new.
Pleading with a crush to take the narrator on and be a constant presence despite the distance.
Pained plea that a lover's departures always take a piece of the singer away with them.
Warning a friend that a charming, manipulative lover will break their heart and should be left alone.
Admitting the singer can no longer resist love for a partner who gives direction and warmth.
Anthem of building a city out of music and culture, defiant against corporate and police control.
Declaration that love is a powerful force that can change anyone and save their life.
Lovesick plea to be remembered by a lost partner while dancing alone in bed.
Plea to cherish each other's love and life while facing the uncertainty of time and fate.
Coming-of-age anthem about burning ambition to break free from the past and reach a brighter future.
Party anthem celebrating heat and dancing, mixed with rambling studio banter and jokes.
A charity call to unite the world, urging people to help those suffering and give what they can.
A defiant outburst urging a listener to vent everything, rejecting a world that demands too much compliance.
A secret affair told by someone sneaking around, hiding passion from friends and a jealous partner at home.

songs.t: Saving All My Love for You
songs.s: A singer reflects on staying loyal to a partner who keeps putting family first, waiting for one night together.
A couple remembers their wild youth and finds that their deep bond feels like heaven, with spoken dedication to Ray Charles.
A frustrated husband complains that he works nonstop for a demanding partner whose wants never end.
A teen is lovesick over a girl and his friends keep warning him to slow down before he gets hurt.
A man begs a woman to let him be her lover, saying he cannot stand the thought of her with anyone else.
A woman declares she wants to be a devoted lover who will rock her partner's world and make him feel alive.
A narrator describes a restless man who was born for the city streets, living in its nightlife and darkness.
A man pleads with his girlfriend to stop seeing other guys and stay loyal, promising her his undivided love.
An invitation to forget daily stress and dance all night at a street party under the lights.
A man pleads for one more night with a woman, saying he cannot wait forever and has loved her for so long.
A lover invites his partner to a romantic sea of love, telling her how much he adores her since they first met.
A dangerous romance with a spy-like lover, where the fatal kiss pulls both into a fiery and doomed dance.
Rebellious youths reject the world that tried to tame them, refusing to lose their wild spirit amid violence and ruin.
A lover declares that a partner is their life's inspiration and that no one needs them more than the singer does.
A worker frustrated by money trouble and a broken heart keeps burning through the grind, hoping a pot of gold will come.
A partner admits the relationship has become a habit, yet insists they belong together through every doubt and hurt.
A tribute to fallen singers and workmates, wishing a departed friend's sweet voice carries on across the night shift.
A call to face fears and keep striving despite skeptics, insisting that if everything is risked, things will still improve.
A man unsure about a new romance says he needs more time to know whether his growing feelings are real.
A joyful drive with a lover in a pink Cadillac down an open road, skipping the exits and rolling on without a care.
A message to people feeling lost and alone, urging them to keep fighting and never give up when the night is dark.
A shy young man is smitten with a girl who does not know his name, and he hopes she will call him.
A woman refuses to be treated as a passive object by a man who wants her to play the role of his baby doll.
A woman who searched for lasting love is overjoyed to find a partner who gives her the good love she always wanted.
A man finally realises that a longtime friend was the true love he had been searching for all along.
A woman mourns a departed lover, asking why he left and wishing she could tell him how much she misses him.
A former couple talks about living separate lives after a hotel call, accepting that they cannot hold on to what they had.
A nostalgic tale of meeting a flirtatious girl in a raspberry beret, riding bikes and falling for her in a small town.
A man describes how love arrived suddenly, changing his world and making him feel alive, and hopes it lasts forever.
A man drives past a former lover's home in an empty summer town, sure his love will endure after the carefree days end.
A chess player in Bangkok finds the city tempting and dangerous, measuring the night's pleasures against his game.

songs.t: If You Love Somebody Set Them Free
songs.s: A repeated plea to free those you love instead of possessing them, warning against control, jealousy and cages.
An obsessive lover craves total possession of a reluctant partner, refusing to accept defeat and vowing to capture her.
A post-apocalyptic plea from a generation left behind, saying they need no savior, only a life beyond the Thunderdome.
A woman playfully declares she values money and wants only suitors who can afford her.
A woman who has been captivated by a partner demands he treat her well and stop offering empty lies.
A lover is swept off their feet and struggles with family pressure, fear and doubt, begging not to be thrown away.
A portrait of a charming, worldly womanizer who plays hearts from city to city, cool and dangerous yet irresistible.
A woman invites her man to her house anytime, promising to satisfy every need and fantasy and ease his worries.
Someone on the run from a violent night is urged to keep in touch, since the singer can only help if they stay reachable.
A couple wants to stay awake together all night in the city, living only in the moment without looking back.
A man with a loving partner keeps returning to a secret affair, because it is so easy to love the other woman.
A nostalgic reflection on a former high school athlete who dwells on past glory, while the narrator knows those days fade.
A woman falls in love but is told to keep quiet, feeling trapped by her partner who wants her to hide her tears.
A man is lured in by a fickle lover who keeps leading him on, and he begs her to be real about her intentions.
A woman insists she is telling the truth while announcing she is leaving a partner she no longer trusts, vowing to make it on her own.
A repetitive chant pleading for a lover to stay close, promising ecstasy and warning against drifting away.
A lover waits for a phone call and promises an end to lonely nights together.
Restless longing for a passionate affair, racing toward a romance that cannot wait.
Nostalgia for a youthful summer of first guitars, a struggling band and a girl at the drive-in.
Euphoric joy at finally being wanted, feeling light and alive as the world brightens.
A hurt narrator rejects a partner who keeps cheating, wanting one faithful love instead.
Regret over a breakup that came too late for goodbyes, with thoughts of despair and wanting to fly away.
A couple strains under money worries and drifting feelings, yet vows to stick together and stay strong.
A playful push to take the leap into passion and let the heat of desire decide.
A love that weathered hard times now feels solid and unchanged, still hot and sure.
Dazzled by a lover who seems angelic, the narrator feels lifted above the crowd on a cloud.
Restless desire for a young woman leaves the narrator burning with longing and wanting her close.
A long-distance romance spelled out in a chant, with calls and dreams bridging a thousand miles.
A lover's touch lifts a weary, lonely narrator, bringing grace and magic back into life.
Heartbroken, the narrator wonders who now has the woman who left and feels replaced.
Two lonely people on a lonely night ask to hold each other and feel less alone.
Urging a guarded partner to open up, the narrator insists love matters before it slips away.
A playful tour of American regions' girls, insisting California has the best of them all.
Smitten by a mysterious new woman in town, the narrator longs to know her and be near her.
A heartbroken narrator asks a former lover why the passion ended and how something so right went wrong.
A flirtatious, boastful invitation to a wild jungle-style love and a night of excess.
A veteran's spoken story of visiting a wounded friend, and memories of a hometown friend lost to life.
A dancer for money keeps men at arm's length, dreaming of wealth, a home by the sea and a family.
A flirtatious battle of wits in romance, with the narrator turning the tables on a suitor.
Regret over walls built around a lover's heart, with a wish to build a bridge and mend things.
Pleading with a lover not to walk away, declaring devotion and needing her to stay.

songs.t: All She Wants to Do Is Dance
songs.s: A country in turmoil, with a woman who only wants to dance and make romance amid the chaos.
A flirtatious promise to dress a lover in devoted, luxurious affection from head to toe.
Warning a street-wise person about the empty nightlife cycle of glamour, heartbreak and self-deception.
A sensual invitation to a lover to spend the night in a warm, passionate embrace.

songs.a: Dionne and Friends ( Dionne Warwick, Gladys Knight, Elton John and Stevie Wonder )
songs.s: A sentimental pledge of friendship that stands by you through good times and bad.
A sorry goodbye to a faded relationship that cannot go on, leaving with no peace in sight.
Missing a lost love, feeling cold and unable to believe the relationship is really over.
After a marriage collapses, the narrator learns to stand alone, find strength and shine again.
Pleading to keep a damaged love together, hoping to learn to fly again on broken wings.
An anxious, dreamy young romance wondering whether a boy feels the same and whether it is real love.
A comic complaint that a girlfriend loves partying all the time and stays out late romancing others.
Two nations clash while an inner battle rages, with burning passion and defiant resolve.
A road-journey meditation questioning one's path and asking others to follow through the darkness.
Obsessive love likened to addiction, unable to resist a lover's kisses and wanting more.
Self-love is the greatest love, with a plea to teach children and refuse to follow others' shadows.
Two secret lovers, guilty and afraid of being found out, yet unable to let go.
A proposal to be both friend and lover to someone, without having to choose one or the other.
A devoted, knight-like lover vows to protect and fight for his partner in the name of love.
A bleak urban town of division, with alienated lives split between the East and West ends.

songs.t: There'll Be Sad Songs (To Make You Cry)
songs.s: Yearning for a love yet to come, with sad songs stirring the feeling of wanting someone to say it back.
Pledging to stay until a love is alive and kicking, even as things threaten to fall apart.
Demanding a partner stop running away and take a chance on the love they both want.
A playful, provocative address to a lover who need not fit a look, with crude jokes and skit-style banter.
Searching for a higher, deeper love in a troubled world, waiting for something better to arrive.
A couple happily stuck together after rough patches, glad to share one life and one phone number.
A young man wants to break free from his controlling family and the fears holding him back.
A playful suitor begs to be let in, using bawdy double meanings to press his courtship.
A man mourns a lost lover and tries to say goodbye after a painful breakup.
A weary figure questions whether they are still human, drifting through detachment and longing.
A lover impatiently waits for the phone to ring and for the beloved to finally be close.
A lover watches the beloved in slow motion and longs for an overwhelming, breathtaking romance.
A giddy, nonsense-filled celebration of a flamboyant pop star and a historic composer.
A pregnant young woman pleads with her father to accept her relationship and her baby.

songs.t: You Give Love a Bad Name
songs.s: A lover is burned by a seductive partner who promised paradise and then caused pain.

songs.t: When the Going Gets Tough, the Tough Get Going
songs.s: Determined to win love, a singer vows to overcome every obstacle and go the distance.
A singer finds that thinking of her lover calms her world and fills her with love.
A dreamer drifts through hazy visions, longing for a world beyond her waking life.
A lover begs not to be forgotten after death, having loved for years without return.
A person hides a painful secret and fears living long enough to finally reveal it.
Two giddy lovers are wildly infatuated, dancing through day and night, lost in each other.
A lover admits imperfection and sings that their partner makes life worth living despite flaws.
A goddess-like woman is celebrated as a fiery, irresistible object of desire.
A party gets so lively that everyone ends up dancing wildly and ecstatically across the room.
A call to the dance floor urges listeners to let the rhythm take over and move.
A friend is urged to show their true self and not hide sadness from those who care.
A high-speed thrill ride is urged, daring the listener to chase danger at full throttle.

songs.t: What Have You Done For Me Lately
songs.s: A woman confronts a lover who stopped the romance, demanding what he has done for her lately.
A lover longs for someone out of reach, held back by insecurity and lingering pain.
A call for utopian unity and joy, critiquing a fragmented, shallow modern world.

songs.t: I Didn't Mean to Turn You On
songs.s: A man protests that he never meant to seduce a date who now expects more from him.
A man struggles to confess love to a departing former partner while the words fail him.
A weary worker dreads Monday mornings and wishes for the weekend instead.
A musician named Johnny plays oldies with energy and rhythm, living out his dream.
A man confesses his love to Amanda, unable to wait any longer to say it.
Two lovers feel their hearts beat as one and celebrate their intense, happy romance.
A person is embarrassed that a secret crush was exposed by a gossiping friend.
A lover pleads for a partner not to leave, hoping they will meet again someday.
A man is drawn in by a woman who seems to hold an irresistible power over everyone she touches.
A lover fears their intense love is too good to last and hopes it continues forever.
A singer urges listeners to find what they need and move forward with confidence.
A singer urges a partner to open up and share hidden secrets without fear.
A bold woman tells men to behave, demanding respect and setting her own boundaries.
A lover begs to be taken home tonight and held close until the light dawns.

songs.t: We Don't Have to Take Our Clothes Off
songs.s: A woman insists a night out needs no undressing, so they dance and party instead.
A worn-out lover has cried over a partner who betrayed them and has nothing left to give.
A narrator craves a night of passion with a lover while hiding shaky feelings.
A confident suitor promises to satisfy his partner and urges her to join him.
A self-deprecating narrator muses about love, power and ego in a cryptic, clever way.
A proud celebration of America, its highways, cities and the freedom of everyday life.
A celebration of rock music and the young bands and singers from American cities.
A lover is teased by a girl who pretends not to know him, leaving him heartbroken and confused.
A party shout-out for a catchy slang word and a crowd chant of the band name.
A giddy, instant love asks why the feeling cannot be real and lasting.
Parents are told to hide in a cellar as war nears, while a voice urges hope and faith.
A woman uses her charm on a lawyer, calling men typical in their weakness for it.
A man says he will stay in his small hometown, valuing its community and comfort over the big city.
A wanderer fantasizes about escaping into a wild jungle life and finding a different world away from home.

songs.t: All I Need Is a Miracle
songs.s: A regretful narrator admits past mistakes toward a former partner and longs for a miracle to bring them back.
An upbeat call to leave the past behind and embrace freedom, love and a bright spirit of the moment.
A giddy narrator declares that a new partner is true love, a perfect fit and a best friend.
A fed-up narrator demands that people stop spreading gossip about him and his friends and let him live.
Townsfolk gather around a storyteller who recalls a 1963 winter and a worker leaving town on a train.

A playful invitation to share a sleeping bag under the stars, with jokes about a trip to Egypt and its pyramids.
A narrator anticipates a woman who keeps him hooked and dazed, teasing him with her unpredictable allure tonight.
A narrator pleads for a second chance, admitting his pride caused trouble and promising to win back a lover's trust.
A flamboyant celebration of unconventional romance, with sensual fantasies in a limousine and dancing on rooftops.
A narrator begs a partner to reconsider a breakup, insisting he will not leave and she will regret it.
A flirty narrator suggests a night alone together, wanting closeness and willing to drop the rules to be near.
A feverish narrator, amid a heatwave and city chaos, pleads for a secret romance around election day.
A narrator yearns for a woman behind a wall of guns and gates, longing to reach her and know her world.
A narrator who cannot remember his life asks to be taken home, feeling trapped and numbed by those controlling him.
A rap recounts a former high-school outcast's flirting and dance-floor romance, ending with a request for a kiss.
A devoted narrator promises steady love to a partner and insists their sweet bond will last forever.
A narrator reminisces about a lost love from the past, wondering whether the former partner still thinks of him.
A playful title-song boast about slick undercover agents who dance their way out of trouble and never need disguises.
An infatuated narrator is overwhelmed by a desirable partner and begs for passionate romance and lovemaking.
A narrator warns a dreamer who wants to run away that her escape fantasies and a smooth-talking man are a lie.
A narrator lies alone longing for a partner's tender love, surrendering to closeness and candle-lit romance.
A narrator says love matters more than money, fame or diamonds, and would give up a kingdom to be with his lover.
Two lovers stand together against hardship and a cruel world, insisting that love will ultimately prevail.
A frightened narrator admits love scares him, fearing being used and hurt, and wishes he had never met.
A heartbroken narrator says he will get over a lost love once his heart stops breaking and forever is through.
A narrator tells a young woman who left home for him to go back, but his life collapses and he loses everything.
A novelty song describes characters in a bazaar and marketplace doing a stiff, stylized walk and dance moves.
A narrator says they do not want to be alone, longing for a lover whose feelings stay hidden and out of reach.
A narrator has been watching a woman across the room and offers a telepathic, seductive promise of loving her.

songs.t: I Wanna Dance with Somebody (Who Loves Me)
songs.s: A narrator wants to dance and feel the heat with someone who loves them, urging everyone to join in on the floor.
A couple vows to stand strong together, ignoring critics, building a dream and staying heart to heart forever.
A narrator grumbles about dull work and a breakup, then shrugs it off as simply how life goes.

A traditional folk song celebrating the bamba dance and the grace needed to dance it, with a playful captain line.

songs.t: Didn't We Almost Have It All

songs.t: I Still Haven't Found What I'm Looking For
songs.s: A restless seeker climbs and runs for love yet still feels unfulfilled, placing hope in a coming spiritual kingdom.
A persistent suitor openly pleads for sex and love from a reluctant partner, insisting he is sincere and patient.
Defiant cynicism toward powerful people who buy witnesses and lie, refusing to be silenced or compromised.
Regret over a lost love; the singer wishes to hold them again, but only in dreams.

songs.t: (I've Had) The Time of My Life
songs.s: Ecstatic gratitude to a lover who made the singer feel more alive than ever before, with thrilling passion.
Having been hurt before, the singer resolves to love more wisely, hoping the next love will be this one.
A supportive friend urges someone to lean on them through hard times, and asks for help in return.
The singer teases a standoffish admirer, promising love if he lets his guard down and opens up.
The singer admits being swept up in feelings for someone, doubting whether the crush is returned.
Regret after a one-night fling; the singer realizes the affair was a mistake and wishes he had left.
Pleading with a distant lover to give love and devotion, after feeling abandoned and emotionally left behind.
Frustrated with an ex who keeps coming back, the singer demands to be let go and allowed to move on.
A flirtatious suitor jokes about being kept at arm's length until marriage, retelling his frustrated courtship with humor.

songs.t: I Knew You Were Waiting (For Me)
songs.s: After painful past heartache, the singer found strength and trusts that a waiting true love was destined for them.
Having outgrown parental control, the singer now claims independence, making her own choices about life and career.
A playful narrator is smitten with a striking woman whose look and style he finds irresistible and bold.
Two lovers separated by distance hope that love will bring them together somewhere out beyond the sky.
Angry at a chaotic, war-haunted world of greedy leaders, the singer calls on his generation to change things.
A singer rejects a televangelist's pitch for salvation and money, choosing steady self-improvement over easy promises.
Entranced by a mysterious, fiery girl who dazzles everyone, the singer is caught spinning helplessly in her orbit.
A singer chooses a new partner who is far better than an old flame, feeling sure the new love is right.
A bold singer begs a lover to touch her and feel her body, wanting intimacy that night with no hesitation.

songs.t: I Just Can't Stop Loving You
songs.s: Overwhelmed by devotion, the singer says life would be worthless without his lover, and he cannot stop loving them.
A flirty dancer tells a partner their opposite styles would create a commotion together, urging compromise and fun.

Two lovers agree to slow down and wait before going further, promising the love will be worth the patience.
Once a rebel, the singer now plays it straight and cheerfully says conformity is the cool, fashionable choice.
A man pleads for his partner to promise lasting love, saying he cannot go on alone without her devotion.
Heartbroken, the singer asks a former lover to tell sweet little lies, since the truth is hard to bear.
A tenant describes violence at home next door and asks neighbors not to question the abuse they hear.
A woman cuts off a cheating ex after hearing rumours he is heartbroken, unsure whether to forgive him.
A warning to aspiring stars that Hollywood's promises and flattery mean nothing until a contract is signed.
Saying goodbye to a lover, the singer wonders if this is the last farewell and hopes they will meet again someday.
A romantic asks everyone to leave them alone with a lover, since their intimate groove should not be disturbed.
Dreaming of San Pedro, the singer longs for the island's warm breezes, its samba and a tender Spanish lullaby.
A boastful singer warns rivals that he is tough and bad, daring them to challenge him and admit his supremacy.
Bleak commentary on 1980s social ills: drugs, violence, disasters and war, while technology and spectacle distract people.
The singer waits patiently for a former lover to change their heart and turn things around, staying close as a friend.
Tired of routine work, the singer invites a lover to escape together into the night and leave everyday pressures behind.
A lover pleads that both partners try harder and set aside pride, because their love is worth fighting for.
Apologizing for neglect, the singer promises to make love to his partner and become the lover they deserve.
Heartbroken by a lover who keeps leaving, the singer hears the rain and the sad banjo as she turns away.
A call to break out of stalled situations, stop asking permission, and say what you want.
A man spiraling into drug dependence and desperation begs for help, promising to make things right tonight.
Consoling a girl after a breakup, the singer promises to wait and be faithful, hoping she'll choose him someday.
A lover's soul-soothing singing makes the narrator forget everything, while his partner packs up and leaves.
The singer swears he is no womanizer, begging his lover to let him prove his devotion and never leave.

songs.a: Gloria Estefan and Miami Sound Machine
songs.s: An upbeat chant warns that nobody can resist the irresistible rhythm, which will get you on the dance floor tonight.
After a long wait, two lovers finally connect and dance all night, rocking steadily until the break of dawn.
A lonely outlaw rider drifting from town to town, haunted by the road and the nights alone.
A striver boasts about rising from a small town to big-city wealth, growing ever more excessive and self-absorbed.
Celebrating life's fleeting beauty and a lover's embrace, urging us to live fully while time runs out.

A lover longs for a promised dream home and a devoted relationship, left alone and waking to loss.
A cocky lover vows to win a restless partner's heart and swears he is saving his love for the future.

songs.t: Nothing's Gonna Change My Love for You
songs.s: A devoted lover pledges unwavering love and promises to stay steadfast through any hardship the future brings.

A pining lover longs to reunite with an absent sweetheart and win back her affection.
A partner warns a leaving lover that life alone will be hard and nobody else will love her as much.

songs.t: Doing It All for My Baby
songs.s: A devoted husband describes his daily life with his wife, working hard to show her constant, lasting love.
A dancer tries clever moves to win back a distracted partner's attention, asking whether it will bring them back.

Warned by past experience, a lover admits being in love is hard, realising it is easy to get hurt once trapped.

songs.t: (You Gotta) Fight for Your Right (To Party!)
songs.s: A rowdy teen rebels against school, parents and rules, insisting that partying is a right worth fighting for.
